title: The Koi Pond: A Strongly Lensed Protocluster Core hosting a Diverse Population of DSFGs
background_knowledge: 宇宙在红移 $z \sim 1\text{--}3$ 的“宇宙中午”（Cosmic Noon）时期迎来了恒星形成活动的最巅峰。原星系团则是现代宇宙中巨型星系团的高红移、致密前身，记录了早期宇宙中星系密集环境下的生长与演化。富含尘埃的恒星形成星系（DSFG）在这一时期贡献了绝大部分的恒星质量增长，但由于大量尘埃吸收了紫外与光学光子并将其以远红外及亚毫米波段重新发射，对其内部细节的观测极具挑战。强引力透镜效应作为一种“天然的宇宙望远镜”，利用前景星系团的强大引力场放大背景源，能够突破现有望远镜的空间分辨率极限，为天文学家精细解剖早期极端环境中的星系形态、气体动力学及恒星演化路径提供关键机遇。
contribution:
本文利用詹姆斯·韦布空间望远镜（JWST）和阿塔卡马大型毫米/亚毫米阵列（ALMA）对红移 $z = 2.67$ 的强引力透镜原星系团核心“锦鲤池”（编号 PJ0846+15）进行了高分辨率观测，取得以下核心科学发现：
- 结合 NIRCam 与 ALMA 6 波段的连续谱测量，在空间分辨率达到约 $0.15^{\prime\prime}$ 的条件下，研究团队在前景色团的强透镜放大作用下，在该区域内确认了 11 个速度弥散在 $\Delta V = 800\text{ km s}^{-1}$ 范围内的富含尘埃的恒星形成星系（DSFG）。
- 观测揭示了这些 DSFG 丰富多样的形态特征，包括旋臂、棒结构、核球、星团/致密团块、潮汐尾及位移的气体库；通过静止帧颜色与连续谱分析发现，其恒星质量跨度超过 $1\text{ dex}$，尘埃消光红化达到 $\Delta A_{\mathrm{V}} > 1\text{ mag}$。
- 结果表明，尽管核心区域存在富气体的并合系统，但许多最红且尘埃发射最强的成员实际上是表现出团块状结构的盘星系，暗示长期演化同样能驱动强烈的星爆事件。
- 这一极端环境展现出的多样化星系属性表明，原星系团核心中的 DSFG 遵循着多种不同的演化路径，最终向宁静的椭圆星系过渡。
summary: We present James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) and Atacama Large Millimeter Array (ALMA) observations of PJ0846+15, \textit{The Koi Pond}, a strongly lensed protocluster core at Cosmic Noon. This field offers a magnified view of 11 dusty star-forming galaxies (DSFGs) all at $z=2.67$ (within $ΔV=800$ km s$^{-1}$) spanning a projected extent of $>300$ kpc lensed by a $z=0.77$ foreground cluster. NIRCam and ALMA Band 6 continuum measurements map the stellar distribution and thermal dust emission respectively at a spatial resolution of $\sim$0.15$^{\prime\prime}$. This analysis reveals a diverse population of DSFGs, with evidence of both interacting and non-interacting systems exhibiting a wide range of morphological features including spiral arms, bars, bulges, clumps/stellar clusters, tidal tails/debris and displaced molecular gas reservoirs. Comparing the rest-frame J- band continuum (F444W) vs (i-J) color (F277W$-$F444W), we find a wide range of values, suggesting a $>$1-dex spread in stellar mass and a dust attenuation reddening of $ΔA_{\mathrm{V}} > 1$ mag. The DSFG members exhibit varying dust sizes relative to the stellar emission, ranging from compact dusty cores to galaxy-wide emission. Resolved color maps of individual sources showing a spread as high as F277W$-$F444W$=2$ mag suggesting complex stellar-to-dust geometry. Although gas-rich mergers are identified in the core, the most red and dust emitting members are disks exhibiting clumpy structure indicating secular growth can drive these starburst events. Such a remarkable range in properties within this sample suggest DSFGs in protocluster core environments follow diverse evolutionary pathways towards their transition into quiescent, elliptical cluster galaxies.

title: Coronal gas excitation as a tracer of supermassive black hole mass: on the mid-IR coronal [Ne v] lines
background_knowledge: 在活动星系核（AGN）研究中，精确测量超大质量黑洞（SMBH）的质量是理解星系与黑洞协同演化的核心。传统的黑洞质量测量方法主要包括恒星或气体动力学方法以及混响映射等，但这些方法往往依赖于高空间分辨率的光谱观测、耗时的大样本监测，或者受限于特定的光度与红移范围。高电离态的日冕线通常产生于窄线区或更靠内核的电离气体区域，其激发状态对中心吸积盘发出的电离连续谱形态极其敏感。由于标准吸积盘的连续谱特征与黑洞质量密切相关，因此利用日冕线辐射特征来探寻潜在的黑洞质量代理指标，为大样本 AGN 黑洞质量的精确测量提供了一条极具前景的新途径。
contribution:
本文基于 27 个活动星系核（AGN）样本的 Spitzer 空间望远镜中红外光谱数据，系统研究了中红外日冕线（如 $\rm [Ne\,v] 14\mu m$ 和 $\rm [Ne\,v] 24\mu m$）与超大质量黑洞（SMBH）质量之间的内在联系。主要科学发现与工作如下：
- 通过对高信噪比的日冕线进行高斯拟合，并将其光通量归一化至宽线区的 $\text{Br}\gamma_{\text{broad}}$ 发射线，研究人员发现 $\rm [Ne\,v] 14\mu m / Br\gamma_{\text{broad}}$ 以及 $\rm [Ne\,v] 24\mu m / Br\gamma_{\text{broad}}$ 线强度比与 SMBH 质量之间存在显著的强相关性，其弥散度分别仅为 $0.54\ \text{dex}$ 和 $0.53\ \text{dex}$。
- 测得日冕气体的电子密度量级约为 $1000\ \text{cm}^{-3}$，结合 JWST 观测子样本得出的密度结果，进一步证实了这些日冕线起源于核区。
- 该研究从观测上支持了日冕气体的激发状态对电离连续谱形态敏感、从而反映 SMBH 质量的理论预期，充分证明了**利用日冕线作为 SMBH 质量代理指标**的可行性，为未来在 AGN 中实现准确的黑洞质量测量开辟了新方向。
summary: Coronal lines (CL) may be a reliable proxy of supermassive black hole (SMBH) masses in active galactic nuclei (AGN) because the production of these high ionisation potential (IP) lines is sensitive to the shape of the ionising continuum which, for a thin accretion disc, relies on the black hole mass. In this work we study the connection between the [Ne\,v] coronal lines and the SMBH mass. We analyse the \textit{Spitzer spectra} of a sample of 27 AGN spanning three orders of magnitude in SMBH mass. Fluxes and the electron density in the coronal gas medium were measured after fitting Gaussians to both the $\rm [Ne\,v]14μm$ and $\rm [Ne\,v]24μm$ lines where detected at high signal to noise. Line fluxes were normalised to the Br$γ_{\rm broad}$ emission from the broad line region. We found strong correlations between the $\rm [Ne\,v]14μm/Brγ_{\rm broad}$ and $\rm [Ne\,v]24μm/Brγ_{\rm broad}$ line ratios and the SMBH mass. For this sample of 27 AGN we find scatters of 0.54 and 0.53 dex, respectively. These correlations support the theory that the coronal gas excitation is sensitive to a range of SMBH masses because of the dependence on the shape of the ionising continuum. The electron densities of the coronal medium are of the order 1000$\rm cm^{-3}$ supporting their nuclear origin. A comparison with density values derived from JWST for a subsample of objects confirm this conclusion. These results further demonstrate the ability to use CL as a SMBH mass proxy, allowing for accurate SMBH mass measurements in AGN.

title: Star Formation in the H II Region Sh 2-205: 3D Morphology and Kinematics from Young Stars and Molecular Gas
background_knowledge: H II 区是大质量恒星电离周围星际介质形成的炽热气体区域。大质量恒星的辐射、恒星风和超新星爆发等反馈机制会对周围的分子云产生显著影响，从而触发或抑制新一代恒星的形成。结合高精度的天体测量数据（如来自 Gaia 卫星的视差与自行数据）与分子气体观测（如 CO 谱线），研究人员能够重建恒星形成区的三维形态、运动学特征及恒星形成历史，这对于理解银河系内的恒星诞生与星际介质循环具有重要意义。
contribution:
本文利用 Gaia 卫星的天体测量数据与 CO 分子气体观测，对 H II 区 Sh 2-205 （简称 S205）及其周围的恒星形成区进行了系统的三维结构、运动学及演化历史分析。主要科学发现包括：
- S205 在全球和小区域尺度上均表现出复杂的形态和相干的膨胀特征。
- 识别出数颗 O9-B1 型星以及一颗年龄约为 0.56 Myr 的脉冲星，它们极有可能与该区域相关。
- 动量估算表明，这些大质量天体的恒星反馈足以驱动观测到的整体膨胀。
- 通过膨胀的追溯分析以及年轻星团的色光图拟合，揭示了该区域至少存在两次独立的恒星形成爆发事件，展现了 S205 复杂的恒星形成历史与三维演化图景。
summary: Using Gaia astrometry of young stars combined with CO observations, we present the first systematic three-dimensional (3D) analysis of the structure, kinematics, and evolutionary history of the star-forming regions in the environs of the H II region Sh 2-205 (S205). S205 exhibits a complex morphology and coherent expansion on both global and subregional scales. We identify several O9-B1 stars and a 0.56 Myr old pulsar that are likely associated with the region. A momentum estimate suggests that feedback from these objects may account for the observed overall expansion. Trace-back analysis of the expansion, combined with color-magnitude diagram fitting for young star clusters, indicates at least two episodes of star formation. These results reveal a complex star-formation history of S205 and provide new insights into its 3D evolution.

title: Identifying AGNs from X-ray detections$-$II: Metallicity calibrations for the $\rm N_2O_2$ and $\rm N_2S_2$ diagnostics
background_knowledge: 在活动星系核研究中，中心超大质量黑洞的吸积活动会产生强烈的辐射场，对周围的气体产生电离。测量窄线区（NLR）的气相化学丰度（金属丰度）对于理解星系与超大质量黑洞的共同演化以及宇宙化学演化历史至关重要。然而，传统主要针对恒星形成星系开发的金属丰度诊断方法，在应用于活动星系核时往往会受到强硬电离辐射场的严重干扰，导致电离连续谱的变化掩盖或偏置真正的金属丰度测量结果。因此，发展能够将化学丰度与入射辐射场解耦的专用诊断方法，是现代活动星系核光谱学研究的重要前沿。
contribution:
该论文针对活动星系核提出了全新的 $\rm N_2O_2$ 和 $\rm N_2S_2$ 诊断半经验金属丰度标定关系，旨在将化学丰度从复杂的入射辐射场中独立出来。核心工作与发现包括：
- 通过将庞大的 CLOUDY 光电离模拟网格与内禀 $2\text{--}10\text{ keV}$ X 射线光度（即 $L_{\rm X}$）直接耦合，并利用来自 BAT AGN 光谱巡天（BASS）的赛弗特 2 型星系样本进行基准标定，建立了适用于金属丰度 $8.0 \lesssim 12+\log(\text{O/H}) \lesssim 9.1$ 的稳健关系，对应的丰度区间为 $0.2 \lesssim Z/Z_{\odot} \lesssim 2.6$ 的范围。
- 发现 $\rm N_2O_2$ 和 $\rm N_2S_2$ 指标能够追踪窄线区内空间重合的发射区域，从而有效解决了此前在标准 $\rm N_2$ 和 $\rm N_2O_3$ 指标中发现的由 $L_{\rm X}$ 驱动的显著系统偏差。
- 研究表明，$\rm N_2O_2$ 比值对星云结构变化几乎完全免疫，而 $\rm N_2S_2$ 指标由于 $[\text{S II}]\lambda\lambda 6716, 6731$ 双线的低临界密度（即 $N_{\rm c}$），表现出对电子密度（即 $N_{\rm e}$）的微弱敏感性。
- 这两种诊断方法均能提供高精度的金属丰度限制，其中 $\rm N_2O_2$ 的均方根残差弥散达到了 $0.081\text{ dex}$ 的精密水平，$\rm N_2S_2$ 的均方根残差弥散则达到了 $0.121\text{ dex}$ 的水平，是被高度优化且无偏的活动星系核金属丰度示踪剂。
summary: Emission-line ratios from ions with nearly identical ionization potentials offer a robust solution to the degeneracies inherent to traditional active galactic nuclei (AGNs) metallicity diagnostics. We introduce new semi-empirical metallicity calibrations for the $\rm N_2O_2$ and $\rm N_2S_2$ diagnostics, explicitly designed to isolate the chemical abundance from the incident radiation field. By coupling an extensive grid of CLOUDY photoionization simulations directly to the intrinsic 2$-$10 keV X-ray luminosity ($L_{\rm X}$) and benchmarking against Seyfert~2 nuclei from the Burst Alert Telescope AGN Spectroscopic Survey (BASS), we establish robust relations valid across the metallicity regime of $8.0 \lesssim 12+\log({\rm O/H}) \lesssim 9.1$ ($0.2 \lesssim Z/Z_{\odot} \lesssim 2.6$). The $\rm N_2O_2$ and $\rm N_2S_2$ indices trace co-spatial emitting volumes within the narrow-line regions (NLRs), enabling this framework to resolve the significant $L_{\rm X}$-driven systematic biases we previously identified in the standard $\rm N_2$ and $\rm N_2O_3$ indices. While the $\rm N_2O_2$ ratio proves to be virtually independent of nebular structural variations, the $\rm N_2S_2$ index exhibits a subtle, yet discernible, electron density ($N_{\rm e}$) susceptibility due to the low critical density ($N_{\rm c}$) of the [S II]$λ\lambda6716,6731$ doublet. Nevertheless, both diagnostics yield highly precise metallicity constraints with tight root-mean-square residual dispersions of $\sim 0.081$ dex for $\rm N_2O_2$ and $\sim 0.121$ dex for $\rm N_2S_2$. We propose the $\rm N_2O_2$ and $\rm N_2S_2$ calibrations as highly optimized, unbiased metallicity tracers for AGNs.

title: JWST Whirlpool Galaxy Treasury: Mid-Infrared Emission in M51 and its Relation to Gas Column and Star Formation
background_knowledge: 在星系演化与恒星形成研究中，星际介质是由气体（包括分子气体、原子气体和电离气体）、尘埃以及多环芳香烃 （PAHs） 等成分交织而成的复杂系统。中红外波段的尘埃连续谱和多环芳香烃辐射能够有效追踪星际介质的空间分布、物理状态以及恒星形成活动。通过高分辨率的多波段红外成像结合多形态气体发射线观测，天文学家能够深入剖析星际物质的微观物理过程、辐射驱动机制及其在星系尺度上的物质循环与恒星反馈图像。
contribution:
利用 JWST 的 MIRI 仪器对 M51 涡状星系在 8 个宽带滤光片下的中红外成像数据，本研究详细探究了多环芳香烃与尘埃连续谱发射同分子气体（$\text{CO}(1-0)$）、原子气体（$\text{HI}$）及电离气体（$\text{Pa-alpha}$）之间的空间关联。主要科学发现包括：
- 在分子气体主导的区域，于 $40\ \text{pc}$ 尺度上，以 PAH 为主的滤光片（F560W、F770W、F1130W、F1280W）同 $\text{CO}(1-0)$ 呈现出**近乎线性的关联**，表明 PAH 与分子气体混合均匀且经历的辐射场强度相对恒定。
- 尘埃连续谱为主的滤光片（F1500W、F1800W、F2100W）与 $\text{CO}(1-0)$ 的相关性斜率较浅，但与 $\text{Pa-alpha}$ 呈现出**近乎线性的标度关系**，反映了其对高辐射场恒星形成区的敏感性；而 PAH 波段由于在电离区容易被破坏，未表现出此类线性趋势。F1000W 的表现与 PAH 波段类似。
- 采用气体和星形成关联成分的经验分解模型表明，PAH 滤光片受两者的贡献相当，而与 $\text{Pa-alpha}$ 相关的相对贡献随波长增长而增加，在 F2100W 中高达 75%。
- 在 $440\ \text{pc}$ 分辨率下，总气体面密度 $\Sigma_{\text{HI+H}_2}$ 与 PAH 滤光片之间存在**紧密的线性关系**，暗示 PAH 同样与原子气体保持良好的混合状态。
summary: Using JWST/MIRI imaging of M51 in eight broadband filters, we investigate correlations of mid-infrared emission from polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) and dust continuum with molecular, atomic, and ionized gas traced by CO(1-0), HI, and Pa-alpha, respectively. In molecular gas-dominated regions, PAH-dominated filters (F560W, F770W, F1130W, F1280W) exhibit near-linear correlations with CO(1-0) at 40 pc scale, indicating that PAHs are well-mixed with gas and experience relatively constant radiation field intensities. The F1500W, F1800W, and F2100W dust continuum-dominated filters show shallower slopes with CO(1-0), reflecting contributions from star-forming regions with high radiation field intensities. This is reinforced by the near-linear scaling between F2100W and Pa-alpha. PAH-dominated bands do not show this linear trend with Pa-alpha, likely due to their destruction in ionized regions. F1000W behaves similarly to PAH bands in its correlations with CO(1-0) and Pa-alpha. Modeling mid-infrared emission with an empirical decomposition into gas- and star-formation-associated components shows that PAH-dominated filters receive comparable contributions from both, while the relative contribution associated with the Pa-alpha template increases toward longer wavelengths, reaching $\sim$75% in F2100W. These results demonstrate that mid-infrared simultaneously traces the gas column and star formation, but with a systematic wavelength-dependent shift in what drives the correlations: PAHs being more gas-tracing and dust-continuum reflecting star formation. Lastly, considering both HI and H$_2$ at 440 pc resolution, we find a tight, linear relation between $Σ_{HI+H_2}$ and PAH-dominated filters. Although most of our coverage is in H$_2$-dominated regions, we note similar observations with HI, suggesting that PAHs are also well-mixed with atomic gas.

title: A Cross-Band (X-ray $\times$ Optical) Periodicity Search for Supermassive Black Hole Binaries: A Null Result and the First Completeness-Corrected Constraint
background_knowledge: 在层级星系形成框架中，超大质量双黑洞（SMBHB）是星系合并的必然产物。搜寻和证认亚秒差距量级的 SMBHB 对于理解星系演化以及引力波天文学（如脉冲星计时阵列）具有重要意义。活动星系核（AGN）在 X 射线和光学等电磁波段的光变往往表现出准周期性特征，这常被用作寻找 SMBHB 候选体的观测指征。然而，AGN 吸积盘和日冕表现出的随机光变（如阻尼随机游走，即 DRW）容易产生假周期信号，因此结合多波段联合搜寻、严格的统计显著性检验以及完备性修正，是确保候选体真实性的关键。
contribution:
本文首次开展了基于 X 射线与光学跨波段协同准周期性的超大质量双黑洞（SMBHB）大样本系统性搜寻，分析了 1194 个 Swift-BAT 硬 X 射线活动星系核（AGN）样本（第一阶段）及 175 个 4XMM-DR14 AGN 样本（第二阶段）。主要科学发现与贡献包括：
- **零结果**：在所选样本中未发现任何符合共同周期的可靠候选体，所有光变曲线均可用阻尼随机游走（DRW）模型合理解释。
- **完备性修正的上限约束**：基于 Lomb-Scargle 周期图、蒙特卡罗显著性检验以及零信号模板检验，给出了在 $P = 100\text{--}900\text{ d}$ 周期范围内**完备性修正的 95% 置信度共同周期比例上限**：当硬 X 射线调制振幅 $\gtrsim 0.3$ 时比例 $\lesssim 3\%$，振幅为 0.2 时约为 15%。
- **观测限制因素识别**：研究表明，当前搜寻的敏感度主要受限于硬 X 射线监测数据而非光学光度测量或统计方法。结合 BAT 黑洞质量函数积分，理论预计的共同周期比例本身极低（$\sim 3\times10^{-2}\, f_{\rm bin}\, \delta_{\rm mod}$），因此得到零结果符合理论预期。
- **方法学贡献**：交付了一套经验证的跨波段搜寻分析框架，为即将到来的爱因斯坦探针（Einstein Probe）和 eROSITA 等更高密度的 X 射线监测数据奠定了基础。
summary: We present the first sample-level search for supermassive black hole binaries (SMBHBs) requiring coherent quasi-periodicity at a common period in the X-ray and optical bands, over 1194 Swift-BAT hard X-ray AGN (Stage 1) and 175 4XMM-DR14 AGN (Stage 2). No source is a co-periodic candidate. Each light curve is modelled as a damped random walk (DRW) and searched with a Lomb-Scargle periodogram and a look-elsewhere-corrected Monte-Carlo significance. Because DRW red noise is largely independent between corona and disc, we require both bands individually significant with periods coincident within 5%, and gate the survivors with the model-independent null-signal-template test of Robnik et al. (2024). Over $P=100$-$900$ d the completeness-corrected 95% upper limit on the co-periodic fraction is amplitude-dependent: $\lesssim 3\%$ for hard-X-ray fractional modulation $\gtrsim 0.3$, $\approx 15\%$ (precision-limited) at 0.2, and uninformative below $\sim 0.15$ (the $ε=1$ floor is 0.25%). The sensitivity is set by the hard X-ray monitoring, not the optical photometry or the statistics, the opposite of the usual assumption. Daily MAXI and RXTE/ASM monitoring of the brightest AGN raises the X-ray completeness 5-8-fold, and the search remains null. Integrated over the BAT black-hole mass function, the expected all-amplitude co-periodic fraction is $\sim 3\times10^{-2}\, f_{\rm bin}\, δ_{\rm mod}$ (modulo a factor $g<1$), with $f_{\rm bin}$ the sub-pc binary fraction, $δ_{\rm mod}$ the modulating duty cycle, and $g$ the fraction reaching recoverable hard-X-ray amplitude, so a null is expected. We deliver a validated cross-band framework and the first completeness-corrected constraint on the co-periodic fraction, ready for the denser X-ray monitoring of Einstein Probe and eROSITA.

title: The linear dilaton in cosmology and particle physics
background_knowledge: 在现代高能物理与宇宙学中，额外的空间维度是解决粒子物理中等级问题及探索量子引力与全息对偶（如 AdS/CFT 对偶）的重要理论框架。自 1999 年 Randall 和 Sundrum 提出基于五维反德西特（AdS）背景的膜世界模型以来，全息原理在研究强耦合体系和引力理论中得到了广泛应用。除了 AdS 空间，线性膨胀子（Linear Dilaton, LD）背景则是另一个具有重要理论意义的五维时空，它与弦论中的小弦理论密切相关。通过研究这些高维时空背景及其全息性质，物理学家能够深入探讨标准模型之外的新物理、宇宙学演化机制以及暗物质的本质。
contribution:
本文综述了一类由实参数 $\nu$ 参数化的五维时空背景，系统推广了传统的反德西特（AdS）与线性膨胀子（LD）理论（其中 $\nu = 0$ 对应 AdS，$\nu = 1$ 对应 LD）。论文重点探讨了该五维理论在粒子物理与膜世界宇宙学中的应用：
- 在粒子物理方面，该理论可将五维普朗克标度降至次普朗克水平；
- 在膜世界宇宙学方面，基于五维黑洞诱导出的额外真空，研究发现体空间传播场呈现出带能隙的连续谱，这与“非粒子”概念紧密相连；
- 提出了一个无压力的全息流体候选者，其与标准模型仅有微弱的引力相互作用，且与热浴解耦，能够通过暴胀后的冻结机制生成，从而扮演暗物质的角色；
- 指出暗物质还可能源于辐射修正下连续引力子传播子自能所产生的孤立共振态，即长寿命、微弱相互作用的大质量引力子。
summary: A warped extra dimension in a five-dimensional (5D) anti de Sitter (AdS) background was introduced in 1999 by Lisa Randall and Raman Sundrum to solve the gauge hierarchy problem in particle physics. As a bonus, a holographic interpretation in terms of four dimensional (4D) conformal field theories (CFT) was found. Interestingly enough, another 5D background, the linear dilaton (LD), was found to have a holographic interpretation in terms of Little String Theory. In this review we will show how a set of 5D backgrounds, parametrized in terms of a real parameter $ν$, generalizes both theories and gives rise, in particular, to AdS for $ν=0$ and to LD for $ν=1$. Furthermore, working in the 5D theory, we will consider applications of the LD background to: i) Particle Physics, so that the 5D Planck scale can be lowered to sub-Planckian values, ii) Brane World Cosmology (BWC), based on the appearance of an extra vacuum characterized by a 5D black hole. In all cases we find a gapped continuum for bulk propagating fields, which makes connection with unparticles. In the case of BWC we also point out on the existence of a pressureless holographic fluid which could play the role of dark matter (DM), with feeble (gravitational) interactions to the Standard Model (SM), decoupled from the thermal SM bath, and generated by a freeze-in mechanism after inflation. We also point out the additional possibility of identifying DM with a long-lived feebly interacting massive graviton, as an isolated resonance generated by radiative corrections to the continuum graviton propagator self-energy.

title: Galaxy Morphology Classification: Uncertainty Modeling and Out of Distribution Detection
background_knowledge: 随着现代大规模天文巡天项目（如 DECaLS）的发展，海量星系图像的自动化处理与分类成为星系形成与演化研究的核心需求。传统的深度学习模型在进行星系形态分类时，面对分布外（OOD）数据、罕见形态或图像伪影时往往会给出过度自信的错误预测，且缺乏可靠的不确定性量化。因此，在天体图像分类中引入先进的不确定性估计与分布外检测方法，对于提高自动化处理的鲁棒性、识别未知或罕见星系形态具有重要意义。
contribution:
论文提出了一种将改进的分布外（OOD）检测与不确定性量化相结合的星系形态分类综合框架。主要工作与科学发现包括：
- 基于 Galaxy Zoo DECaLS 数据集和 ResNet-34 架构，对比并评估了标准交叉熵基线、IsoMaxPlus 损失函数以及 IsoMaxPlus 联合蒙特卡洛 Dropout（MC Dropout）的混合配置。
- 采用以基于距离的类别表征替代传统 SoftMax Logits 的 **IsoMaxPlus 损失函数**，在保持 97% 竞争力的九分类形态准确率的同时，将 TNR@TPR95 相对交叉熵基线提升了近 90%，显著增强了 OOD 检测能力。
- 将 IsoMaxPlus 与 **MC Dropout** 相结合，通过在推理过程中执行多次随机前向传播提供快速贝叶斯近似，有效提高了模型预测的稳定性并减少了校准误差。其中，预期校准误差（ECE）从基线的 0.0095 分别降至 0.0026（约 73% 的降幅）和 0.0033（约 65% 的降幅）。
- 发现错误分类或低置信度的预测结果表现出更高的预测熵和更小的最小距离得分，为识别不可靠预测提供了可解释的指标。该方法非常适合当前及未来的大规模天文巡天数据处理需求。
summary: We present a comprehensive framework for galaxy morphology classification that combines enhanced ``out-of-distribution (OOD)'' detection with improved uncertainty quantification. Using ``Galaxy Zoo DECaLS'', we trained a ResNet-34 architecture under three configurations: standard cross-entropy loss as a baseline, IsoMaxPlus loss function for OOD detection, and hybrid IsoMaxPlus+MonteCarlo Dropout for enhanced uncertainty quantification. IsoMaxPlus replaces the conventional SoftMax logits with distance-based class representations, preserving inter-class separability and enabling reliable OOD detection, without requiring additional architectural modifications or hyperparameter tuning. Coalescing IsoMaxPlus with MC Dropout provides a fast Bayesian approximation by performing multiple stochastic forward passes during inference. Our results show that IsoMaxPlus substantially improves OOD detection, increasing TNR@TPR95 by nearly $90\%$ relative to the cross-entropy baseline, while maintaining a competitive accuracy of 97\% across nine morphological classes. Additionally, with MC Dropout, the model yields more stable predictions and a reduction in calibration error, providing more reliable uncertainty estimates. The Expected Calibration Error (ECE) is reduced from $0.0095$ to $0.0026$ ($\approx73\%$) for IsoMaxPlus and $0.0033$ ($\approx65\%$) when combined with MC Dropout, compared to the baseline. Misclassified or underconfident predictions exhibit higher predictive entropy and lower minimum distance scores, providing an interpretable metric for identifying unreliable predictions. These methods are well-suited for current and upcoming large-scale surveys, where reliable automated morphological classification and awareness of uncertainty are essential for identifying rare or previously unseen galaxy morphologies.

title: Mixing stochasticity relinquishes evidence for magnetorotational hypernovae
background_knowledge: 在银河系晕中，极贫金属星保留了早期宇宙星际介质的化学丰度印记，是研究早期恒星演化、超新星核合成以及重元素（如 r 过程元素）起源的关键恒星样本。传统的化学演化研究通常探讨单次极端爆发（如磁转动超新星）对奇异丰度模式的贡献，然而，星际介质中物质的随机混合与多次事件的共同联合富集（如普通核心坍缩超新星与中子星并合的协同作用）在普适性的化学演化图景中同样占据重要地位。通过对恒星表面丰度模式进行高精度的统计建模，天文学家能够有效甄别不同天体物理机制对元素起源的相对贡献。
contribution:
针对近期一项声称某晕星的奇异元素丰度模式只能由单次磁转动超新星事件解释的研究，本论文提出了不同的观点与更优的统计模型：
- 核心工作：研究人员引入了**随机混合模型**（即 mixing stochasticity），将普通核心坍缩超新星（爆发能量约为 $10^{51}\ \text{erg}$）与中子星并合（即 NSM）的核合成产物进行了联合拟合。
- 主要发现：相比于单次磁转动超新星假说，随机混合模型能够显著更好地解释该晕星的丰度模式，其均方根误差 r.m.s 从 0.44 大幅降低至 0.24。
- 科学结论：这一结果表明，该恒星的化学成分更倾向于源自常见天体事件的协同贡献（核心坍缩超新星与中子星并合），而非稀有的磁转动超新星。此外，论文还深入探讨了该恒星的起源及其诞生云团同时受到这两种事件富集的可行性。
summary: A recent work claimed by fitting the observed elemental abundance pattern of a halo star with the total yields from single super-/hypernova events that only a magnetorotational hypernova event (a very energetic supernova event that also produces r-process elements) could be the source of the observed abundances. Here, we show that the star's peculiar abundance pattern is better fitted within the framework of mixing stochasticity with yields from a normal core collapse supernova (ccSN; Energy$_{\rm exp}$ $\sim 10^{51}$ erg.) and a neutron star merger (NSM). The stochastic mixing model outperforms the hypernova fitting significantly, (r.m.s 0.24 vs 0.44) i.e., favours the composition from common events (ccSN + NSM) over the magnetorotational hypernova scenario. We also discuss the origin of the star and the possibility of enrichment of its birth cloud by both a ccSN and a NSM.

title: Detection of Aliphatically Deuterated Aromatic Hydrocarbons in the Large Magellanic Cloud 30 Doradus Star-Forming Complex
background_knowledge: 在星际介质的研究中，未证认红外发射（UIE）带是一类普遍存在于多种天体环境中的特征光谱，通常被归结为多环芳香烃（PAHs）等碳氢化合物分子的 C--H 与 C--C 键伸缩和弯曲振动。这些红外特征是连接恒星形成活动、星际尘埃演化及宇宙有机化学的重要桥梁。通过红外光谱探测星际介质中的同位素效应（如氘代）以及脂肪族侧链结构，能够为揭示星际复杂有机分子的合成路径与演化历史提供关键的物理和化学线索。
contribution:
本研究基于詹姆斯·韦布空间望远镜（JWST）搭载的近红外光谱仪（NIRSpec）和中红外仪器（MIRI）对大麦哲伦星系（LMC）中 30 Doradus 恒星形成区的高空间分辨率观测，取得了以下核心发现：
- 证实了 30 Doradus 中的未证认红外发射（UIE）源具有显著的脂肪族成分，并广泛发生了氘代作用。
- 在空间解析光谱中大范围探测到了源自脂肪族 C--H 伸缩与变形振动的 $3.4\ \mu\text{m}$ 和 $6.85\ \mu\text{m}$ 发射特征，以及源自脂肪族 C--D 伸缩振动的 $4.65\ \mu\text{m}$ 发射特征。
- 首次观测到 $6.85\ \mu\text{m}$ 特征光谱展现出三个复杂的精细子结构，分别位于约 $6.83\ \mu\text{m}$、$6.86\ \mu\text{m}$ 和 $6.88\ \mu\text{m}$ 处。
summary: The unidentified infrared (IR) emission (UIE) bands at 3.3, 6.2, 7.7, 8.6, 11.3 and 12.7 micron are ubiquitously seen in a wide variety of astrophysical environments. While the exact assignment of these UIE bands remains controversial, they are generally ascribed to C--H and C--C stretching and bending vibrations of aromatic hydrocarbon molecules. Here, based on observations made with the Near Infrared Spectrograph (NIRSpec) and the Mid Infrared Instrument (MIRI) aboard the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST), we report that the UIE emitters in the 30 Doradus star-forming complex in the Large Magellanic Cloud (LMC) are deuterated and have an appreciable amount of aliphatic content. The spatially resolved NIRSpec and MIRI spectra of 30 Doradus reveal a widespread detection of the 3.4 and 6.85 micron emission features attributed to aliphatic C--H stretch and deformation, respectively, as well as the 4.65 micron feature attributed to aliphatic C--D stretch. Notably, the 6.85 micron feature exhibits three complex substructures at ~6.83, 6.86 and 6.88 micron that have never been reported before.

title: Local Interstellar Flow Parameters from the First Intersection of IMAP-Lo's Parameter Tubes
background_knowledge: 太阳在星际介质（ISM）中运动，会形成一股穿过日球层的星际中性（ISN）原子流。其中，ISN 氦（He）由于具有极高的宇宙丰度与相对较低的电离率，成为 1 au 附近最丰沛的星际物质成分，也是测定局域星际流参数的理想示踪物。历史上的星际边界探测器（IBEX）由于采用固定的观测朝向，其测量结果在 4D 参数空间中表现为高度延伸的“参数管”，从而带来较大的系统不确定性。
contribution:
本研究基于星际测绘与加速探测器（IMAP）搭载的 IMAP-Lo 仪器，利用其可转动的枢轴平台实现了对 ISN 流的多角度观测，成功获取了延伸角分别为 $79^\circ$ 、 $94^\circ$ 和 $109^\circ$ 的参数管交截结果，显著降低了系统不确定性。主要科学发现包括：
- 精确测定了局域星际流参数：流速为 $26.37 \pm 0.82\text{ km s}^{-1}$ ，黄经方向为 $74.85^\circ \pm 0.96^\circ$ ，黄纬方向为 $-5.212^\circ \pm 0.035^\circ$ ，温度为 $7740^{+770}_{-730}\text{ K}$ 。
- 推断出的极局域星际介质（VLISM）流场既不吻合局域星际云（LIC），也不吻合 G-Cloud，而是表现为一种中间状态。
- 该研究展示了 IMAP 解析复杂临近星际区域物理图景的能力，为理解日球层如何响应局域星际流及演化奠定了基础。
summary: The Sun's motion through the interstellar medium creates a flow of interstellar neutral (ISN) atoms through the heliosphere. ISN He, due to its high universal abundance and relatively low ionization rate, is the most abundant of the interstellar species near 1 au and ideal for flow parameter determination. The Interstellar Boundary Explorer (IBEX) measurements of ISN He flow parameters (speed, temperature, and direction) yielded a tube in 4D parameter space -- narrow in cross-section but highly extended along one parameter axis (e.g., ecliptic longitude direction). This ``4D parameter tube'' results in large systematic uncertainties, a direct consequence of IBEX-Lo's fixed viewing orientation on the spacecraft. On the Interstellar Mapping and Acceleration Probe (IMAP), the articulation of the IMAP-Lo boresight using its pivot platform enables multiple viewing orientations of the ISN flow for significant systematic uncertainty reduction. We provide first results that definitively intersect ISN parameter tubes for elongation angles $79^\circ$, 94$^\circ$, and 109$^\circ$, resulting in precise interstellar parameters: speed $26.37 \pm 0.82$ km s$^{-1}$, ecliptic longitude direction $74.85^\circ \pm 0.96^\circ$, ecliptic latitude direction $-5.212^\circ \pm 0.035^\circ$, and temperature $7740^{+770}_{-730}$ K. The inferred flow of the Very Local Interstellar Medium is not consistent with either the Local Interstellar Cloud or the G-Cloud, but rather an intermediate state. IMAP is now positioned to study the detailed physics of this complex, nearby interstellar region. By resolving and understanding its physics, we determine how the heliosphere responds to the local interstellar flow, and how it may evolve in time

title: Addressing position anomalies in the Strong Gravitational Lensing System HS~0810+2554 through Dark Matter Subhalos
background_knowledge: **强引力透镜效应**是指来自遥远光源的光线在经过前景大质量星系或星系团的引力场时发生强烈偏折，从而产生多重像、弧或环的现象。在标准冷暗物质 $\Lambda\text{CDM}$ 宇宙学框架下，星系晕被预言包含大量的小质量暗物质子晕。传统的平滑宏观透镜模型虽然能够解释大尺度的透镜构型，但在拟合多重像系统的精确位置和通量时常出现异常。这些微小异常能够敏感地反映不可见的暗物质子晕引力扰动，因此成为检验暗物质小尺度性质的关键探针。
contribution:
本研究利用甚长基线干涉测量（VLBI）对强引力透镜系统 HS 0810+2554 的两个四重像系统观测数据，探讨了暗物质子晕对图像位置异常的解释能力。主要科学发现与工作包括：
- 采用椭圆幂律宏观透镜模型，并结合来自数值模拟的冷暗物质子晕群体，对全部八个射电图像执行了双源重建拟合。
- 研究发现，质量低于 $10^{6}\ M_\odot$ 的子晕所诱导的天体测量学偏移小于测量不确定度，而质量更大的子晕能够自然产生所需的毫角秒级微扰，且不会显著破坏全局透镜构型。
- 在模型中引入冷暗物质子晕后，$\chi^2$ 从纯宏观透镜的 60.38 显著优化至 1.61。
- 这表明 HS 0810+2554 的位置异常完全可以在标准的冷暗物质框架内得到解释，并不必然依赖模糊暗物质等非标准模型或宏观透镜的角向复杂性，为探测冷暗物质预言的子晕群体提供了清晰且可检验的观测证据。
summary: Self-bounded dark matter (DM) subhalos are predicted to populate galactic halos in great abundance in the Cold Dark Matter (CDM) scenario. These substructures can leave observable imprints in strong gravitational lensing and have shown the ability to account for flux-ratio and position anomalies in multiply imaged systems. In this paper, we utilize the DM subhalos to address the image position anomalies of the two radio quads of HS 0810+2554 observed with the Very Long Baseline Interferometry. We model the lens using an elliptical power-law macro-lens supplemented by a population of CDM subhalos from numerical simulations and perform a dual-source reconstruction to fit all eight radio images simultaneously. We find that subhalos below $10^{6}M_\odot$ induce astrometric shifts smaller than the measurement uncertainties, whereas more massive subhalos naturally generate the required milliarcsecond perturbations without significantly altering the global lens configuration. Including CDM subhalos improves the fit from $χ^2=60.38$ for the pure macro-lens to $χ^2=1.61$. Our results show that the position anomalies of HS~0810+2554 can be explained within the CDM framework and do not by themselves necessarily require non-standard scenarios like fuzzy DM or angular complexity in the macro-lens. Instead, they provide a sharp and testable manifestation of the subhalo population predicted by CDM.

title: Wide field Slitless Spectroscopy with JWST's MIRI
background_knowledge: 詹姆斯·韦布空间望远镜（JWST）搭载的中红外仪器（MIRI）覆盖了 $4.9 - 28\ \mu\text{m}$ 的波长范围，是研究宇宙早期星系、恒星形成及星际介质的重要利器。无狭缝广域光谱（WFSS）观测模式允许在较大的视场内同时获取多个目标的光谱信息，极大地提升了观测效率。然而，中红外波段面临着复杂的背景辐射挑战，因此开发高精度的背景扣除、波长定标和绝对流量定标算法，是实现该模式科学产出的核心基础。
contribution:
本文介绍了 JWST 的 MIRI 仪器全新推出的无狭缝广域光谱（WFSS）模式（将于 2026 年 7 月开始的第 5 周期首次提供）的相关进展与筹备工作。核心贡献包括：
- 详细描述了这一全新观测模式的核心能力与运行概念。
- 概述了当前正在进行的仪器定标与数据处理流程开发活动，旨在为用户提供高质量的、经过背景扣除以及波长和流量定标的中红外光谱数据。
summary: We present a snapshot of the ongoing efforts to obtain background-subtracted, wavelength-, and flux-calibrated spectra taken with the new Wide-Field Slitless Spectroscopy (WFSS) mode for the MIRI instrument on the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST), offered for the first time in JWST Cycle 5 (starting July 2026). We describe here the capabilities of the new mode, the operational concept, and an overview of the calibration and pipeline development activities that are currently ongoing.

title: An open-source data processing pipeline for Keck / NIRC2-Polarimetry
background_knowledge: 天文偏振观测是研究天体磁场分布、散射机制及几何结构的重要手段。由于望远镜和光学系统自身会引入额外的偏振效应，高精度的定量偏振观测高度依赖复杂的仪器偏振标定，通常需要利用**穆勒矩阵**（Mueller Matrix）模型进行精细修正。因此，开发高效、可靠的数据处理流水线是消除仪器系统误差、实现高信噪比偏振成像的关键技术支撑。
contribution: 针对 **Keck 望远镜** **NIRC2** 红外成像仪全新升级的偏振观测模式（NIRC2-Pol），本文设计并介绍了一个灵活、易用且**开源的数据处理流水线**。文章总结了该流水线架构的核心步骤及当前的具体实现细节，为利用该仪器开展系外行星、银河系中心、活动星系核及太阳系天体等前沿天文偏振研究奠定了重要基础。
summary: The Keck/NIRC2 infrared imager was recently upgraded with a new suite of polarimetric observing modes. This polarimetry upgrade (referred to as NIRC2-Pol) will open up a wide range of new astronomical studies, including investigations of exoplanets, the Galactic center, active galactic nuclei and the solar system. Astronomical polarimeters require sophisticated data reduction, especially for quantitative polarimetry requiring the use of a Mueller Matrix model for instrumental polarization calibration. This work presents the design of a flexible, user-friendly, open-source data processing pipeline intended for use with NIRC2-Pol, summarizing its key steps and details of its ongoing implementation.

title: Stress-Testing DANTE under Detector Domain Shift: a Representation-Coherent Reanalysis of LIGO O4a
background_knowledge: 在引力波天文学中，地基引力波探测器（如 LIGO）的数据中包含大量非高斯、非平稳的瞬态噪声（通常被称为毛刺），这些噪声会严重干扰真实引力波天体信号的搜寻与认证。为了实现自动化、高效的探测器状态表征与噪声甄别，学界常采用无监督机器学习与域适应技术。然而，随着探测器升级及不同观测批次（如 O3 与 O4）间仪器状态和环境的演化，探测器域漂移会导致模型性能下降。因此，研究不同表示框架下噪声管道的鲁棒性、量化其失效模式，对于确保引力波数据分析的可靠性具有重要意义。
contribution:
该论文基于第六版瞬态评估域自适应网络（DANTE），对 LIGO O4a 观测期的 10,429 个候选体进行了表示相干的重新分析。主要科学发现与核心工作包括：
- 利用冻结的 DINOv2 特征嵌入与 Top-k 多实例得分，将候选样本划分为 6,365 个稳健样本、1,275 个模糊样本和 2,789 个背景样本，其中大量历史处置结果较 v5 版本发生了改变。
- 揭示了无监督探测器表征中的多项关键失效模式，包括 O3b 至 O4a 的得分漂移、条件性低 $Q$ 值盲区以及对背景抽取、聚类种子和白化处理的敏感性。
- 严格的统计检验（如无富集表现 $p = 1.000$）表明原有部分统计特征不具备可交换性。
- 撤回了 v5 版本中的新发现、事件率限制、星表召回率及全巡天稳定性解释。最终指出，该工作测定了无监督探测器表征的失效模式与有效性条件，并非发现新的毛刺类别或开展天体物理搜寻。
summary: This sixth version of the Domain-Adaptive Network for Transient Evaluation (DANTE) preprint stress-tests an unsupervised transient-noise pipeline under representation mismatch and observing-run adaptation. We reanalyse 10,429 detector-time strain candidates from 42 LIGO O4a sessions using frozen DINOv2 patch embeddings and a Top-k multiple-instance score. Candidate and native-background Q-transforms share Q in [4,64], and detector-specific thresholds are calibrated from 5,000 run-native windows by temporal-block bootstrap. The coherent analysis yields 6,365 ROBUST, 1,275 AMBIGUOUS, and 2,789 BACKGROUND statistical dispositions; 4,676 of 10,372 paired historical dispositions differ from the cross-representation v5 analysis. Direct controls resolve an O3b-O4a score shift and reduction after native adaptation for H1, but not L1, while known-glitch separation is detector- and morphology-dependent. Replicated studies quantify population-dependent sensitivity to background draw, clustering seed, dictionary size, and whitening, demonstrate native-index absorption, and identify conditional low-Q blindness. A conservative H1-L1 max-shift screen yields 13/8,806 values above threshold, but its on-source values and pooled per-event null maxima are not exchangeable. The primary two-null PEM endpoint shows no resolved ROBUST-BACKGROUND enrichment (p=1.000), and two catalogue overlaps are consistent with a circular-shift coverage proxy (p=0.651). Simulation-only compact-binary controls show detector- and distance-dependent disagreement between novelty, native disposition, and physical coincidence. We withdraw the v5 discovery, rate-limit, catalogue-recall, and survey-wide stability interpretations. The supported result is a measured set of failure modes and validity conditions for unsupervised detector characterization, not a new glitch class or an astrophysical search.

title: Parameter estimation in differential equations: Mathematical foundation for satellite gravimetry, review and perspectives
background_knowledge: 卫星重力测量是通过精确追踪人造地球卫星的轨道运动来反演地球重力场的关键技术，在地球科学、大地测量学及全球变化研究中具有核心地位。其基础物理图像依托于牛顿万有引力和轨道动力学，核心研究范式是通过建立描述卫星运动的微分方程，将卫星的轨道摄动与地球重力场空间分布联系起来。长期以来，如何从高精度的星地与星间追踪数据中克服建模误差、实现高分辨率与高精度的全球重力场反演，一直是该领域的核心挑战。
contribution:
本文围绕卫星重力测量中的微分方程参数估计问题展开了系统研究，核心工作与主要科学发现包括：
- 建立了一个统一的卫星重力测量微分方程参数估计理论框架。
- 系统回顾并评述了计算地球重力场的主要数学方法，涵盖配置法、Kaula 线性摄动法、两点边值问题、基于轨道能量的方法及数值积分方法，并指出了常规数值积分方法在数学和物理上的局限性。
- 提出了一种基于测量数据的摄动理论用于估计地球重力场，该方法理论上无建模误差，能够充分利用任意长度的精密卫星轨道及高精度追踪数据，为实现高精度、高分辨率全球重力场模型奠定了坚实基础。
- 结合参考重力模型，针对散射追踪数据推导出了卫星运动牛顿非线性控制微分方程的局域解。
summary: Satellite gravimetry has become essential in many areas of earth science. However, the resolution of satellite gravitational models remains low at scales of a few hundreds km and no gravity recovery methods can take full advantages of unprecedented high accuracy of satellite tracking measurements. We first provide a unified theoretical framework of parameter estimation in differential equations for satellite gravimetry and then briefly review the mathematical methods to compute the gravity field of the Earth from satellite tracking. We focus on the collocation method, Kaula linear perturbations, two-point boundary value problems and orbit-energy-based methods. The numerical integration method is also included in this review, though it has been proved to be mathematically incorrect and physically not permitted. The reason is that it has become the standard method to routinely produce global gravitational models from satellite tracking data, which have been widely applied in many different areas of earth science. Because it is not clear how the incorrect foundation would affect gravity products from satellite tracking, we do not review any applications of these products. We then present a measurement-based perturbation theory to estimate the gravity field of the Earth, which can fully utilize both precise satellite orbits of arbitrary length and unprecedented high accuracy of satellite and inter-satellite tracking. The method is theoretically free of modeling errors, is capable of extracting any small forces from satellite and inter-satellite tracking data and provides a guarantee for high-precision and high-resolution global gravity models. Finally, we assume a reference gravity model and derive local solutions to the Newton's nonlinear governing differential equations of satellite motion for scattered tracking data that can still be important in some applications.

title: The reddening of NGC 7469 and evidence for variable extinction
background_knowledge: 活动星系核 AGN 的中心引擎由超大质量黑洞驱动，其周围的宽线区与连续谱辐射会受到星际尘埃的吸收与散射，从而产生明显的红化与消光效应。利用多波段监测数据和多种红变指示标，天文学家能够精确估算尘埃消光量 $E(B-V)$ 的大小。这不仅能够还原 AGN 的本征连续谱与发射线特征，还可用于探测中心区域尘埃的物理性质、几何分布及其时变特性，对理解 AGN 结构与黑洞周边物质吸积过程具有重要意义。
contribution:
本论文基于 1996 年国际活动星系核监测计划 International AGN Watch 的多波段监测数据，利用 7 种不同的红变指示标，对赛弗特星系 NGC 7469 的宽线区与连续谱红化情况进行了全面估计。主要科学发现包括：
- 证实了该源的速度积分宽氢线比接近 Case B 复合辐射理论值，与此前对 NGC 5548 的研究结果一致。
- 测得在 1996 年中期，NGC 7469 具有显著的消光量 $E(B-V) = 0.44 \pm 0.03$ 的特征。
- 发现该消光量在 1996 年为期 7 周的监测期间内表现出约 10% 的逐渐增加趋势。
- 结合长达数十年的光学监测数据，证明了该源的消光在年际尺度上也存在适度的变化。
summary: We estimate the reddening of the broad-line region and continuum of the active galactic nucleus NGC 7469 during the 1996 International AGN Watch multi-wavelength monitoring campaign using seven different reddening indicators. As was found for NGC 5548, these indicators support velocity-integrated broad hydrogen line ratios being close to Case B values. All the indicators point to substantial reddening of E(B-V) = 0.44 +/-0.03 for NGC 7469 during mid-1996. We find evidence for a gradual increase of about 10% in the reddening during the seven weeks of the 1996 campaign. Decades-long optical monitoring before and after the campaign is also consistent with modest changes in the extinction from year to year.

title: Improved constraints on the Milky Way potential using the M68 stream and DESI spectroscopic data
background_knowledge: 银河系及其周边的恒星流是由球状星团或矮星系在银河系潮汐力作用下被撕裂后形成的碎屑。由于恒星流弥散在广阔的相空间中，其轨道对银河系的引力势极其敏感，因此成为探测银河系质量分布、尤其是暗物质晕三维结构和银盘质量的重要探针。通过精确测量流中恒星的天球位置、距离、自行以及视向速度，结合动力学模型与 N 体模拟，天文学家能够推断出银河系的引力势参数，为研究银河系的形成与演化以及暗物质性质提供关键约束。
contribution:
本文利用来自 Gaia DR3 的相空间参数以及 DESI 巡天的光谱和光度数据，筛选出了目前包含视向速度测量在内的最大 M68 球状星团恒星流（也被称为 Fjörm）成员星样本，共计 96 颗。主要科学发现包括：
- 观测到的恒星流宽度大于 N 体模拟的预期，且流边缘的恒星在视向速度空间中表现出相关性，暗示这些恒星无法在简单的静态轴对称引力势中被剥离。
- 结合 N 体模拟的模拟样本以及银河系旋转曲线数据，利用符合剥离条件的 44 颗恒星，对银河系引力势进行了严格约束，得出银盘质量 $M_{\rm d} = 5.34 \pm 0.57 \times 10^{10}\ M_\odot$ 以及扁率为 $q_{\rm h} = 0.83^{+0.06}_{-0.05}$ 的扁椭球暗物质晕。
- 通过拟合恒星流轨道，估计 M68 的日心距离为 $r = 10.55 \pm 0.09\text{ kpc}$。
summary: We present a selection of stars belonging to the stellar stream of the M68 (NGC 4590) globular cluster, also known as Fjörm. This star selection is an improvement on previous ones that used only Gaia data, as it incorporates spectroscopic measurements from the DESI survey and photometric data from the DESI Legacy Surveys. The selection contains 96 stars, each with five phase-space parameters from Gaia-DR3 and radial velocity from DESI, covering the entire observed section of the stream. This constitutes the largest selection of M68 stream stars with measured radial velocities to date. The observed stream is wider than expected from N-body simulations, and the stars farthest from the centre of the stream appear to be correlated in radial velocity space. This suggests that these stars cannot have been stripped from the cluster in a static axisymmetric potential. By modelling a mock sample of stream stars created using an N-body simulation, we found that we could reliably constrain the disc mass $M_{\rm d}$ and the dark matter halo axis ratio $q_{\rm h}$ of the Milky Way. This is because the stream flows close to and almost parallel to the disc. Using the 44 stars that are consistent with having been stripped from the cluster, combined with measurements of the Milky Way's rotation curve, we constrain the Galactic potential, obtaining $M_{\rm d} = 5.34 \pm 0.57 \times 10^{10}$ M$_{\rm sun}$ and an oblate halo of $q_{\rm h} = 0.83^{+0.06}_{-0.05}$. Additionally, by fitting the stream track, we estimate the Heliocentric distance of M68 to be $r=10.55\pm0.09$ kpc.

title: An ALMA view of the Jet-Arc CO clouds toward the TeV $γ$-ray source HESS J1023-575 and Westerlund 2; Evidence for the footprints of microquasar jets, the very powerful cosmic-ray accelerator in the Galactic disk
background_knowledge: 在高能天体物理学中，研究银河系内的超高能 $\gamma$ 射线源与宇宙线加速机制是理解高能宇宙的关键方向。长期以来，超新星遗迹被认为是银河系中局域宇宙线的主要加速器。然而，包含致密星（如黑洞或中子星）的微类星体系统能够通过相对论性喷流向星际介质注入巨大的机械能。当这些高速喷流与周围的中性氢（$\text{HI}$）以及一氧化碳（$\text{CO}$）分子云相互作用时，会通过激波和粒子加速过程留下独特的形态学特征。研究这些喷流与星际介质的相互作用，不仅能揭示极端天体环境下的粒子加速物理，还能帮助天文学家搜寻银河系中潜在的超强宇宙线加速源。
contribution:
本文利用 ALMA 对 TeV $\gamma$ 射线源 HESS J1023-575 方向的 Jet-Arc 一氧化碳（$\text{CO}$）分子云进行了亚秒差距尺度的观测，取得了以下核心科学发现：
- 发现了大量宽度约为 $0.5\text{ pc}$ 的薄细丝状分子云结构，其长度达 $10$--$20\text{ pc}$ ，这些细丝与 Jet-Arc 喷流轴高度对齐。
- 结合磁流体力学微类星体喷流模型，证实这些细丝状结构正是微类星体喷流在星际中性氢（$\text{HI}$）气体上的“足迹”，并成功解释了两侧云团形态差异的原因。
- 在强子辐射机制下，计算出该源的宇宙线质子能量 $W_{\rm p}$ 高达 $7 \times 10^{48}\text{ erg}$ ，这比典型 TeV $\gamma$ 射线超新星遗迹高出一个数量级以上。
- 研究表明 HESS J1023-575 的活跃时间长达 $1$--$10\text{ Myr}$ ，其总能量相当于至少 1000 个超新星遗迹，极有可能是银河系盘中最强大的宇宙线加速器，其内部可能隐藏着一个因严重消光而长期被掩盖的百万年量级黑洞或中子星。
summary: The TeV $γ$-ray source HESS J1023-575 (HESSJ 1023 hereafter) is one of the brightest H.E.S.S. sources near the young massive cluster Westerlund 2. HESS J1023 shows a remarkable positional alignment with the Jet and Arc CO clouds on its eastern and western sides over 170 pc length. We have carried out sub-pc scale observations of the CO clouds with ALMA and have discovered that the clouds consist of numerous thin filamentary features of $\sim$0.5 pc width and 10--20 pc length at distance of 7.5 kpc, which are well aligned with the Jet-Arc axis. Based on the magneto-hydrodynamical model of microquasar jets launched from {the center of the $γ$-ray source} HESS J1023-575, we present an interpretation that the thin filamentary clouds are the footprints of the microquasar jets on the HI gas. The model also explains the dissimilar Jet vs. Arc clouds in terms of HI density difference on each side. By using the density of the CO and HI gas and the $γ$-ray luminosity, we have calculated the cosmic ray proton energy $W_{\rm p}$ to be 7$\times$10$^{48}$ erg under the hadronic scheme, which is ten times larger than those derived in the TeV $γ$-ray SNRs RX J1713.7-3946 and RX J0852.0-4622. It is likely that HESS~J1023 has been active over 1-10 Myr, which is significantly longer than the duration of cosmic ray acceleration of the SNRs. HESS~J1023 is therefore an outstanding source of cosmic rays equivalent to at least 1000 SNRs, and is possibly the most powerful CR accelerator in the Galactic disk. A high energy compact source in HESS~J1023, which is likely a Myr-old black hole or neutron star, remains veiled due to heavy extinction.

title: VAPOLA - A multiyear, multiband polarization survey of AGNs and Sgr A* at millimeter wavelengths with ALMA II. Spectropolarimetric properties and their evolution from 2017 to 2023
background_knowledge: 活动星系核（AGN）中心通常拥有超大质量黑洞，其吸积流与相对论性喷流会发射出强烈的同步辐射。通过毫米波段的甚长基线干涉测量（VLBI），天文学家能够以极高的空间分辨率穿透致密的核心区。偏振观测涵盖了线偏振度 $LP$ 的测量、电矢量位置角 $EVPA$ 的追踪以及法拉第旋转量 $RM$ 的分析，是探测黑洞附近磁场结构、等离子体物理性质以及吸积和喷流动力学机制的核心工具。其中，法拉第旋转测量能够有效揭示包裹在相对论性喷流外围或吸积流中的磁化等离子体特征，为理解高能天体物理过程提供关键线索。
contribution:
本文利用阿塔卡马大型毫米/亚毫米阵列（ALMA）在 2017 年至 2023 年期间开展的 5 次 VLBI 观测巡天数据，系统分析了包含 39 个活动星系核及银河系中心超大质量黑洞 Sgr A* 在内的样本的光谱偏振性质。核心工作与主要科学发现包括：
- 系统表征了致密核心在总强度和偏振上的特征，重点关注了线偏振度 $LP$ 的行为、电矢量位置角 $EVPA$ 的演化以及法拉第旋转量 $RM$ 随时间和光谱域的变化规律，研究对象涵盖 M87、Sgr A*、3C273、3C279 等典型天体及平谱射电类星体、BL Lac 天体等不同源类。
- 发现虽然总强度和谱指数在周尺度上通常保持稳定，但偏振性质常表现出强烈的变率，其中包含线偏振度 $LP$ 的变化、电矢量位置角 $EVPA$ 的波动以及法拉第旋转量 $RM$ 的漂移，均会发生显著的日间变化。
- 观测到多个源存在大规模的电矢量位置角 $EVPA$ 旋转，并伴随着线偏振度 $LP$ 的变化和法拉第旋转量 $RM$ 的调整，在某些情况下这些变化与耀发活动相吻合。
- 在所有具有可靠多频测量结果的源中，法拉第旋转量 $RM$ 的绝对值随观测频率的增加而增大。这一观测结果与相对论性喷流周围磁化鞘层引起的法拉第旋转相一致，不过源自吸积流的机制（特别是对于 Sgr A* 而言）同样无法被排除。
summary: We present a systematic analysis of the spectropolarimetric properties of a sample of 39 active galactic nuclei and Sagittarius A* observed with the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array during five VLBI campaigns between 2017 and 2023. We characterize the compact cores in total intensity and polarization, focusing on the behavior or the linear polarization fraction (LP), electric vector position angle (EVPA), and Faraday rotation measure (RM) over time and spectral domains. We investigate both individual objects--such as M87, Sgr A*, 3C273, and 3C279--and ensemble properties of different source classes, including flat-spectrum radio quasars, BLLac objects, and other active galaxies. While total intensity and spectral index are generally stable on weekly timescales, polarization properties often exhibit strong variability, with significant day-to-day changes in LP, EVPA, and RM. Several sources display large EVPA rotations accompanied by variations in LP and RM, in some cases coinciding with flaring activity. We observe that the magnitude of RM increases with observing frequency for all sources for which we have reliable multi-band measurements, consistent with Faraday rotation arising in a magnetized sheath surrounding the relativistic jet, although an origin in the accretion flow--particularly in the case of Sgr A*--cannot be ruled out.

title: Enabling Quantitative Polarimetry for Keck/NIRC2: Preliminary Mueller Matrix Model Calibration
background_knowledge: 天文偏振观测旨在测量天体光子的偏振状态，从而揭示恒星形成、星际介质磁场、星周盘及活动星系核等天体物理过程的几何与物理机制。然而，地基望远镜及其复杂的光学系统（如反射镜、半波片、转像镜等）会引入显著的仪器偏振和相位延迟效应。为了实现高精度的定量偏振测量，必须建立精确的穆勒矩阵模型，对光学元件的偏振特性（如双向衰减等）进行精细定标，从而在数据处理中有效剥离仪器自身引入的系统误差。
contribution:
本文针对 2025 年升级后的 Keck/NIRC2 红外成像仪双光束偏振观测模式，构建了涵盖三级镜 M3、半波片、转像镜、下游光学系统及沃拉斯顿棱镜的波长依赖穆勒矩阵模型，并开展了初步定标研究。主要贡献与发现包括：
- 利用各波段包含多种半波片和转像镜角度组合的穹顶平场序列，对模型中 M3 下游的参数进行了约束。
- 通过非偏振标准星观测数据的测量矩阵求逆，测得 M3 在 J、H 和 Kp 波段的双向衰减值分别约为 $0.0119 \pm 0.0009$、$0.0098 \pm 0.0004$ 和 $0.0068 \pm 0.0005$，该结果比穹顶平场直接推导的值更符合铝膜的菲涅耳理论预测。
- 指出穹顶平场中出现的较大调制可能源于照明光源自身的偏振特性或现有穆勒矩阵模型的局限性。
- 该工作为 Keck/NIRC2 确立了初始偏振定标框架，并为后续优化输入偏振约束、固化实验室半波片参数、利用偏振标准星进行模型验证及向 $L'$ 波段扩展指明了方向。
summary: The Keck/NIRC2 infrared imager was upgraded in 2025 with dual-beam polarimetric observing modes spanning approximately 1.1--4.1 microns (JHKL' bands). We present a preliminary JHK calibration of NIRC2 Polarimetry using a wavelength-dependent Mueller matrix model of the Keck tertiary mirror (M3), half-wave plate (HWP), image rotator (IMR), downstream optics, and Wollaston prism. We constrain the model downstream of M3 using dome flat sequences spanning ten HWP and nine IMR angles in each band. Although the model reproduces the dominant modulation, the residuals show structure dependent on HWP and IMR angle. Measurement matrix inversion of unpolarized standard star observations gives M3 diattenuations of 0.0119+/-0.0009, 0.0098+/-0.0004, and 0.0068+/-0.0005 in J, H, and Kp, substantially closer to Fresnel predictions for aluminum than the values derived from dome flats. The larger dome flat modulation may indicate polarization in the incident dome illumination or Mueller matrix model inaccuracies. These results establish an initial calibration framework while motivating improved input polarization constraints, fixed HWP parameters from previous laboratory measurements, model validation with polarized standard stars, and extension to L'.

title: High Velocity Neutral Gas in the Fermi Bubbles: New Kinematic Limits and Spatial Structure
background_knowledge: 银河系风或星系风通常由中心恒星形成活动或活动星系核（AGN）驱动，是星系反馈的重要表现形式，在调节星系恒星形成和星系演化中起着关键作用。费米泡（Fermi Bubbles）是银河系中心向外延伸数千秒差距的巨型双极结构，涵盖了多相介质。通过观测费米泡及银河系核风中的中性氢（\text{HI}）气体，天文学家能够追踪外流物质的运动学特征、空间分布以及加速机制，从而深入理解星系尺度的物质循环与能量注入过程。
contribution:
本研究利用绿岸望远镜（Green Bank Telescope）覆盖银心周围约 500 平方度的最新中性氢（	ext{HI}）巡天数据，在银河系核风中探测到了数百朵被卷携的中性云团。研究团队对其中具有最大视线速度绝对值（$|V_	ext{LSR}|$）的 228 朵费米泡云团进行了详细的运动学与空间分布分析，主要科学发现如下：
- 观测到的云团视线速度范围达到了 $-335	ext{ km/s} \leq V_	ext{LSR} \leq +438	ext{ km/s}$，这是迄今为止报道的与银河系盘面相关的中性 $	ext{HI}$ 结构中的最高正 $	ext{LSR}$ 速度。
- 最高速度出现在距离银心最远的位置，表明云团在从核区附近的低速状态向外运动时，在径向距离 $\lesssim 4	ext{ kpc}$ 处被加速至至少 $500	ext{ km/s}$。
- 云团在被加速的过程中逐渐被瓦解：其谱线亮度和中性氢柱密度（$N_	ext{HI}$）随距银心距离的增加而稳步下降，且云团群体的性质变得更加均匀。
- 在垂直于银道面距离达到 $\approx 2	ext{ kpc}$ 处，中性云团的分布出现了一个急剧的截断。
- 基于填充费米泡体积的外流云团运动学模型表明，气体内部结构暗示该外流在过去曾存在方位角不对称性。
summary: We have detected hundreds of neutral clouds entrained in the Milky Way's nuclear wind using HI data from new surveys made with the Green Bank Telescope that cover about 500 sq-degrees around the Galactic center (GC). Galactic winds are common throughout the Universe, and these data at 9.1' angular resolution (22 pc at the GC) provide the most detailed analysis of the vertical profile of a neutral nuclear wind in any galaxy. A set of 228 of these Fermi Bubble clouds with the largest values of |VLSR| has been analyzed to examine the distribution and kinematics of the outflowing gas. The clouds span -335 km/s $\leq$ VLSR $\leq$ +438 km/s, the largest positive LSR velocities ever reported for neutral HI associated with the Milky Way disk. The highest velocities are found furthest from the GC, suggesting that clouds are accelerated from a low velocity near the nucleus to at least 500 km/s at a radial distance of $\lesssim 4$ kpc. Clouds appear disrupted as they are accelerated: their line brightness and NHI decreases steadily with distance from the GC, and the population becomes more uniform. There is an abrupt cutoff in the neutral clouds at a vertical distance of $\approx2$ kpc from the Galactic plane. Kinematic models of an outflowing cloud population that fills the FB volume are used to identify structure in the gas. The kinematics of the highest velocity, highest latitude clouds imply a past azimuthal asymmetry in the outflow.

title: In-situ measurements of space plasma: recent progress and future challenges
background_knowledge: 空间等离子体（如太阳风及地球空间环境）是研究基础等离子体物理过程的天然实验室。由于实验室条件受限，科学家主要依赖搭载于空间探测器上的原位探测仪器，以高分辨率和极低扰动的方式测量等离子体粒子的速度分布函数与电磁场。现代空间等离子体探测技术（例如顶帽式静电分析器）的发展，为深入理解宇宙中的基本等离子体动力学、粒子加速以及磁流体湍流等物理过程提供了核心技术支撑。
contribution:
本文综述了空间等离子体原位探测技术的最新进展与未来发展方向，其核心工作与主要内容包括：
- 详细阐述了空间等离子体粒子原位探测的现代诊断方法，并重点介绍了**顶帽式静电分析器**的检测原理。
- 结合 **Parker Solar Probe** 与 **Solar Orbiter** 等日球层空间任务的数据，总结了近期在太阳风及空间环境研究中取得的重要科学发现，充分展示了现代空间等离子体仪器的卓越观测能力。
- 讨论了空间等离子体物理学未来的研究方向及在等离子体诊断方面面临的挑战，并展望了多项即将实施或规划中的空间探测任务，例如 **Vigil** 空间天气任务、 **HelioSwarm** 多航天器协同任务、 **M-MATISSE** 火星探测任务以及 **Debye** 电子天体物理任务。
summary: Space plasmas like the solar wind or the Earth's space environment offer unique opportunities to observe fundamental plasma processes and their impact in situ. With modern space instrumentation, we measure the velocity distribution function of the plasma particles as well as the electromagnetic fields at high resolution and with minimal perturbation of the observed plasma systems. Plasma measurements like this are often not possible in laboratory settings on Earth. This review article focuses on modern diagnostic methods for the in-situ detection of plasma particles in space. It presents the detection principle of top-hat electrostatic analysers and highlights recent examples of scientific discoveries based on data from the heliospheric space missions Parker Solar Probe and Solar Orbiter. These examples demonstrate the capabilities of modern space plasma instrumentation. The article then discusses future directions in space plasma physics as well as the involved challenges in terms of the required plasma diagnostics. These new developments include, for example, upcoming and proposed space missions such as the operational space-weather mission Vigil, the multi-spacecraft mission HelioSwarm, the Mars mission M-MATISSE, and the electron-astrophysics mission Debye.

title: Direct Imaging and Gradient-Based Analysis of the 12 August 2026 Partial Solar Eclipse from a Freely Rotating High-Altitude Balloon
background_knowledge: 高空科学气球能够将观测载荷带至平流层，从而有效避开对流层湍流、云层遮挡以及大气水汽吸收，是开展太阳物理学、大气科学及临近空间天文观测的重要低成本平台。传统的太阳或日食观测高度依赖高精度的太阳主动指向系统（active solar pointing），以确保观测目标稳定保持在视场中心。然而，对于轻量化的小型科学载荷，采用被动旋转（passive rotation）的设计方案可以大幅降低系统复杂度与成本。尽管被动旋转会导致目标在图像中随机扫过，但通过结合先进的计算机视觉与基于梯度的边缘检测算法，依然能够从非稳定的宽视场图像中提取出具有科学价值的定量信息，这为未来临近空间的大气与天体观测拓展了新的技术路径。
contribution:
本研究呈报了一项利用自由旋转高空气球对 2026 年 8 月 12 日日偏食进行的原理验证观测，主要核心工作与发现包括：
- 采用从德国奥尔登堡发射的高空气球平台，搭载了两台配备 4K Boost 广角镜头和日食观测滤光片的 Insta360 ONE RS 相机，在飞行期间获取了约 1,300 张间隔照片，其中有 21 张成功捕捉到日食过程的直接图像，完整覆盖了当地日食最大阶段的前后时段。
- 提出了一种基于二维梯度的太阳边缘分析方法，用于从非稳定、无主动稳像的宽视场图像中估计可见太阳面积，并将其归一化至首次观测。
- 观测提取出的日食掩食度曲线与独立计算的日食几何模型高度吻合，皮尔逊相关系数达到 $r = 0.959$，平均绝对偏差为 9.5 个百分点，均方根误差为 11.5 个百分点。
- 证明了被动旋转载荷在无需主动太阳指向系统的情况下，同样能够获取具有半定量价值的日食直接观测数据，并为未来气球载日食测量任务明确了系统校准策略。
summary: We report a proof-of-concept observation of the partial solar eclipse of 12 August 2026 using a freely rotating high-altitude balloon launched from Oldenburg, northern Germany. The payload carried two Insta360 ONE RS cameras equipped with 4K Boost wide-angle lenses; covered by filter material taken from a BRESSER eclipse viewing glass. Interval photographs were acquired every 10 s at ISO 800 and 1/1000 s. Of approximately 1,300 images, 21 contained a directly visible image of the eclipsed Sun, spanning 19:19:15-20:38:21 CEST and both sides of the local eclipse maximum. To test whether quantitative eclipse information could be recovered from these small, non-stabilized wide-angle images, the visible solar area was estimated using a two-dimensional gradient-based solar edge analysis and normalized to the first observation. The image-derived obscuration followed the independently calculated eclipse geometry with Pearson r = 0.959, a mean absolute difference of 9.5 percentage points, and an RMSE of 11.5 percentage points. Systematic deviations are consistent with the limitations of an uncalibrated action-camera system, including point-spread function, field-dependent lens response, filter geometry, and camera-to-camera differences. The results demonstrate that passive payload rotation can yield both visually useful and semi-quantitative direct eclipse observations without active solar pointing, and define a calibration strategy for future balloon-borne eclipse measurements.

title: Optical-NIR Multi-band Photometric Analysis and Characterization of Giant Exoplanets with CPI-C
background_knowledge: 直接成像与多波段光度测量是表征类木行星大气物理性质与演化历史的核心手段。在可见光波段，行星主要依靠反射恒星光，其光谱特征受到甲烷吸收、云层结构及金属丰度的强烈调制；而在近红外波段，行星自身的红外热辐射占据主导地位，能够有效限制其有效温度、表面重力加速度及质量等基本物理参数。通过结合可见光与近红外多波段的观测数据进行联合分析，天文学家可以更全面地解耦行星的半径、轨道参数及大气动力学特征，从而克服单一波段观测带来的简并性问题。
contribution:
本文针对 CPI-C 的核心科学目标，提出了一种基于可见光至近红外多波段光度测量的巨行星表征方法。主要科学发现与贡献包括：
- 详细模拟了 CPI-C 涵盖可见光与近红外波段的 8 个宽带滤光片观测方案，并在模拟中纳入了真实的仪器吞吐量、探测器噪声及残余散斑噪声。
- 证明了可见光波段数据能够有效拟合整体光谱形状、甲烷调制及云层依赖的光谱变化，并对反射光谱形态及半径-轨道联合参数提供敏感度约束。
- 证明了近红外热辐射数据能够更佳地约束有效温度、半径、表面重力及质量等基本行星参数。
- 结果表明，结合可见光与近红外 VIS4+NIR4 数据的联合分析能够显著优于单一滤光片组合，对行星半径及云沉降参数等核心物理量给出更紧致的约束。
summary: We present a multi-band photometric approach to characterize giant exoplanets, which represents one of the anticipated core scientific outcomes of Cool Planet Imaging Coronagraph (CPI-C). CPI-C operates with two observational channels covering visible and near-infrared wavelengths, each equipped with four broadband filters. The planet--star flux ratio integrated over each filter bandpass is calculated for photometric analysis. For cool planets observed in the visible bands, the data are primarily used to fit the overall spectral shape and methane-induced modulation, providing sensitivity to metallicity- and cloud-dependent spectral variations while constraining the reflected-light spectral shape and the combined scaling involving planet radius, orbital separation, and orbital phase. In the near-infrared bands, which probe thermal emission, the data help to better constrain fundamental planetary parameters including the effective temperature, radius, surface gravity and mass. For a synthetic giant planet with measurable reflected-light and thermal-emission components, the combined VIS4+NIR4 data provide tighter same-target constraints than either filter set alone, especially for the planet radius and cloud sedimentation parameter. Our simulations incorporate realistic instrument throughput, detector noise, and residual speckle noise. The results demonstrate that the eight-band design spanning visible to near-infrared wavelengths supports reflected-light diagnostics, thermal-emission characterization, and joint optical--NIR analysis of giant exoplanets within CPI-C science observations.

title: The H$α$ specific angular momentum of dwarf galaxies
background_knowledge: 星系的比角动量 $j$ 与质量 $M$ 之间的关系（通常参数化为 $j \propto M^\alpha$ 的形式，被称为 Fall 关系）是反映星系关键物理与形态学性质的基本定标关系。在宏观视角下，比角动量的大小与分布记录了星系及其暗物质晕的角动量获取与演化历史。长期以来，该关系在质量大于 $10^9\ M_\odot$ 的大质量星系中得到了广泛研究，但对于形态各异、质量极低的矮星系（特别是质量低于 $10^6\ M_\odot$ 的系统）是否依然适用，以及其在宇宙学演化过程中的动态变化，一直是星系形成与演化领域中的重要前沿问题。
contribution:
本研究利用来自 SH$\alpha$DE 调查的 49 个恒星形成矮星系以及 20 个高质量对照星系的 H$\alpha$ 观测数据，将恒星比角动量与质量的关系（$j_*$-$M_*$ 关系）研究推进到了质量低于 $10^6\ M_\odot$ 的极端矮星系区间。主要科学发现包括：
- 观测结果表明，恒星形成矮星系遵循与高质量盘星系相同的 $j_*$-$M_*$ 关系，其幂指数为 $\alpha = 0.53 \pm 0.4$，证明该定标关系在跨越 5 个数量级的质量范围内均成立。
- 结合 IllustrisTNG 宇宙学模拟与模拟观测发现，模拟的矮星系总体上遵循外推的 $j_*$-$M_*$ 关系，但在低 $j_*$ 端出现扁平化现象和显著弥散。
- 动力学演化分析表明，矮星系在演化过程中经历着 $j_*$ 的逐渐流失，而高质量星系则经历 $j_*$ 的突增后趋于稳定，这种复杂的动力学演化导致了 $\alpha$ 随红移发生变化（在 $z = 2$ 时 $\alpha = 0.45$，在 $z = 0$ 时 $\alpha = 0.55$）。这表明尽管现今的 $j_*$-$M_*$ 关系表现得相对简单，但其背后的角动量演化历史极为动态和复杂。
summary: The relationship between a galaxy's specific angular momentum $j$ and its mass $M$, parameterised by $j \propto M^α$ and known as the Fall relation, has emerged as a fundamental scaling relation reflecting key physical and morphological properties of galaxies. This relation has been well studied for galaxies with masses above $10^{9}$ $M_{\odot}$. However, whether or not it holds for the low-mass dwarf galaxies, especially given their varied morphologies, remains uncertain. Here we use H$α$ observations of 49 star-forming dwarf galaxies from the SH$α$DE survey, as well as 20 high-mass `control' galaxies, to investigate the stellar $j_{*}$-$M_{*}$ relation down to masses below $10^{6}$ M$_{\odot}$. We find that the star-forming dwarf galaxies follow the same $j_{*}$-$M_{*}$ relation as high-mass disk-like galaxies, with $α= 0.53 \pm{0.4}$, demonstrating that the relation holds across 5 orders of magnitude in mass. We then select a matching sample from the IllustrisTNG cosmological simulation and create mock observations resembling the SH$α$DE survey. We find that the simulated dwarf galaxy population follows the extrapolated $j_{*}$-$M_{*}$ relation with a flattening and significant scatter towards lower $j_{*}$ values. Following the evolution of these galaxies, we find that dwarf galaxies experience a gradual loss in $j_{*}$ with time, while high-mass galaxies experience a sudden jump in $j_{*}$ before settling into a stable state. This dynamical evolution leads to a redshift dependence in $α$, with $α= 0.45$ at $z = 2$ and 0.55 at $z = 0$. Despite the apparent simplicity in the present-day $j_{*}$-$M_{*}$ relation over a wide mass range, the evolution of $j$ leading to this relation is complex and dynamic.

title: Adapting the 23m LST-North mechanical structure design for the strong Chile seismic environment
background_knowledge: 切伦可夫望远镜阵列（CTA）是下一代地基高能伽马射线天文台，旨在探测宇宙中的超高能伽马射线。大型望远镜（LST）作为 CTA 中口径最大、响应速度最快的核心设备，其机械结构需要兼顾极轻的重量与极高的刚性，以实现在数秒内快速指向观测目标。然而，将北半球原型望远镜设计部署至地震活动频繁的智利南部台址时，必须克服严苛的抗震设计挑战。大型天文望远镜的抗震设计不仅关系到仪器在强震中的结构安全，还直接决定了其光学系统的精度与长期的科学产出。
contribution:
针对智利台址更为严苛的地震环境，马克斯·普朗克物理研究所（MPP）提出了将地震隔离系统与成熟的 LST-1 机械结构设计相结合的改造方案。其核心工作与主要科学发现包括：
- 提出并论证了集成地震隔离系统的创新概念，可显著降低地震载荷与动态放大效应。
- 避免了对望远镜主体结构进行大规模改动，实现了现有成熟设计的低成本、高可靠性迁移。
- 通过详细的**有限元分析**以及长期的**结构寿命评估**，全面验证了该抗震改造方案的可行性与科学有效性。
summary: The 23-meter-diameter Large-Sized Telescope (LST) is the largest size telescope of the next generation Cherenkov Telescope Array (CTA). The first telescope, LST-1, was installed at the Roque de los Muchachos Observatory (ORM) on La Palma at an altitude of 2,250 m in 2018 and has been in operation since 2019. Its ultra-lightweight structure (110 tons) enables extremely rapid repositioning (180° in 18 seconds) and has been designed to withstand extreme environmental conditions, including storms and winds exceeding speed up to 200 km/h. To deploy the same solid telescope design at the CTA Southern Observatory in Chile, the structure must be adapted to the significantly higher seismic demands of the site. To address this challenge, the Max Planck Institute for Physics (MPP) has proposed the integration of a seismic isolation system with the proven LST-1 structural design. This approach substantially reduces seismic loads and dynamic amplification, thereby avoiding extensive structural modifications and enabling the existing telescope design to be transferred to the Chilean site with only minor adaptations. In this contribution, we present the proposed seismic isolation concept and its feasibility studies. MPP is responsible for the mechanical structure of the LST and has validated the concept through detailed finite-element analyses and long-term structural lifetime assessments.

title: Testing a Sign-Switch Cosmological Model with Curvature through Latest Planck 2018, DESI DR2 and PantheonPlus\&SH0ES Observational Data
background_knowledge: 现代宇宙学标准模型 —— $\Lambda\text{CDM}$ 模型成功解释了宇宙的大尺度结构与演化，但仍面临哈勃常数张力及暗能量本质未知等理论挑战。为了缓解这些潜在矛盾，理论物理学家提出了多种动力学暗能量或符号转换暗能量场景，允许有效宇宙学常数在宇宙演化过程中发生符号转变。此外，检验宇宙的空间平坦度（即空间曲率参数 $\Omega_k$ 是否严格为零）是窥探早期暴胀物理及宇宙全球拓扑的关键手段，通常需要联合宇宙微波背景辐射、重子声学振荡以及 Ia 型超新星等多类高精度观测数据来开展严格的统计检验。
contribution:
本文在符号转换暗能量框架（即 $\Lambda_{\rm s}\text{CDM}$ 模型）中引入了自由空间曲率参数 $\Omega_k$ ，系统研究了宇宙的空间几何性质与参数关联。其核心工作与主要发现包括：
- 联合利用最新的 Planck 2018 宇宙微波背景辐射数据、DESI DR2 重子声学振荡测量以及 PantheonPlus&SH0ES Ia 型超新星样本，对 $\Omega_k$ 及其他宇宙学参数给出了联合约束。
- 发现 Planck 独立数据在 $\Lambda_{\rm s}\text{CDM}+\Omega_k$ 和 $\Lambda\text{CDM}+\Omega_k$ 框架下均轻微倾向于一个闭合宇宙，但空间平坦性仍在允许的不确定性范围内。
- 引入低红移观测探针后，空间曲率的约束显著收紧；特别是全套数据集（Pk18+DR2+PP&SH0ES）给出的约束结果为 $\Omega_k = 0.0001 \pm 0.0014$ ，表明宇宙与空间平坦性保持了极高的和谐度。
- 分析了 $\Omega_k$ 、 $H_0$ 与 $S_8$ 之间的参数关联，发现曲率与符号转换暗能量成分的引入有助于稳定宇宙学参数的估计。
- 基于 AIC 与贝叶斯证据的模型比较表明，相比于标准 $\Lambda\text{CDM}$ 模型，$\Lambda_{\rm s}\text{CDM}$ 模型目前仅获得微弱或无决定性的观测支持。
summary: We investigate the spatial geometry of the Universe within the framework of a sign-switch dark energy scenario by extending the recently proposed $Λ_{\rm s}$CDM model to include a free curvature parameter $Ω_k$.In this framework, the effective cosmological constant undergoes a transition from a negative to a positive value at a characteristic redshift $z_{\dagger}$. Using the latest Planck 2018 cosmic microwave background (CMB) data, DESI DR2 baryon acoustic oscillation (BAO) measurements, and the PantheonPlus\&SH0ES Type Ia supernova sample, we derive joint constraints on the spatial curvature parameter $Ω_k$ and other cosmological parameters. We find that Planck data itself slightly favors a closed universe within both the $Λ_{\rm s}$CDM$+Ω_k$ and $Λ$CDM$+Ω_k$ frameworks, although spatial flatness remains well within the allowed uncertainties. When low-redshift probes were included, the curvature constraints were significantly tightened. In particular, the full Pk18+DR2+PP\&SH0ES dataset yields $Ω_k = 0.0001 \pm 0.0014$ for the $Λ_{\rm s}$CDM model, indicating a universe that is remarkably consistent with spatial flatness. We further analyzed the correlations between $Ω_k$, $H_0$, and $S_8$, finding that the inclusion of curvature and a sign-switch dark energy component helps stabilize cosmological parameter estimates while remaining compatible with current observational constraints. Model comparison using AIC and Bayesian evidence shows that the $Λ_{\rm s}$CDM model receives inconclusive/weak observational support relative to $Λ$CDM.

title: Improved Cosmological Constraints from Morphology-Based Marked Correlation Functions
background_knowledge: 宇宙大尺度结构（即宇宙网）由纤维状结构、片状结构、节点和巨洞交织而成，包含了丰富的非高斯宇宙学信息。传统的两点关联函数主要描述密度的两点统计特征，无法完全捕捉宇宙网的形态学特征。为了突破这一局限，标记关联函数（简称 MCF）应运而生。 MCF 通过根据天体或暗物质晕所处的局域宇宙网环境为其赋予特定的标记，能够有效挖掘隐藏在大尺度结构形态中的高阶统计信息，从而显著提升对宇宙学参数（如暗能量状态方程和 $\sigma_8$ 等）的约束能力。
contribution:
该论文提出了一种基于宇宙网形态的标记关联函数（简称 MCF），并结合基于模拟的高斯过程仿真器，用于提升宇宙学参数的约束精度。核心工作与发现包括：
- 利用 Nexus 算法识别暗物质晕的宇宙网形态，并在包含 129 个 $w_0w_a\text{CDM}$ 宇宙学模型的 Kun 模拟套件上构建了以宇宙学参数和示踪体偏差为自变量的 MCF 高斯过程仿真器。
- 将仿真器应用于独立的 Jiutian 模拟的模拟暗物质晕星表，通过联合似然分析量化了宇宙学约束效果。
- 比较了离散形态标记和连续形态强度标记：连续标记将优值图（FoM）提升了约 8.6 倍，并将 $\sigma_8$ 的 $1\sigma$ 不确定度降低了约 5 倍；离散标记则带来了约 17% 的 FoM 提升。
- 通过改变约 4.5 倍的暗物质晕质量阈值测试了示踪体选择的影响，发现在最低质量阈值下连续标记仍然无偏，且其 FoM 约为单独使用两点关联函数的 3.4 倍。这证明了形态学 MCF 与基于模拟的仿真相结合是提取大尺度结构中额外宇宙学信息的有效框架。
summary: The cosmic web contains morphology-dependent information that is not fully captured by standard two-point statistics. We construct morphology-based marked correlation functions (MCFs) by assigning marks to halos according to the cosmic-web morphology identified with the \textsc{Nexus} algorithm. Using the \textsc{Kun} simulation suite, which spans 129 $w_0w_a$CDM cosmologies, we build Gaussian-process emulators for the MCFs as functions of cosmological parameters and tracer bias. We then apply the emulators to mock halo catalogues from the independent \textsc{Jiutian} simulation and perform a joint likelihood analysis to quantify the resulting cosmological constraints. We consider two marker choices: a discrete morphology marker and a continuous morphology strength marker. The continuous marker improves the Figure of Merit (FoM) by a factor of $\sim 8.6$ relative to the standard 2PCF and reduces the $1σ$ uncertainty on $σ_8$ by a factor of $\sim 5$. The discrete marker gives a more modest FoM improvement of $\sim 17\%$. We further test the impact of tracer selection by varying the halo mass threshold by a factor of $\sim 4.5$. Even for the lowest mass threshold, the continuous marker remains unbiased and achieves a FoM about $\sim 3.4$ times higher than that of the 2PCF alone. These results show that morphology-based MCFs, combined with simulation-based emulation, provide a useful framework for extracting additional cosmological information from large-scale structure surveys.

title: Catastrophic Inflation in the Axiverse
background_knowledge: 宇宙暴胀理论描述了早期宇宙经历的指数级加速膨胀，成功解决了标准大爆炸宇宙学的视界与平坦性难题，并为宇宙大尺度结构的形成提供了原初涨落种子。在弦理论的紧化框架中，实现暴胀通常面临极大的理论挑战，往往需要超普朗克尺度的场域跨度或复杂的轴子对齐机制。轴子作为弦理论紧化中普遍存在的赝南布-戈德斯坦玻色子，是天然的暴胀子候选者。然而，如何在受控的弦理论景观中实现缓慢滚动暴胀，特别是对于场域跨度小于普朗克尺度的亚普朗克小场暴胀模型，一直是理论物理学界的核心研究方向。
contribution:
本文研究了基于型 IIB 弦理论在卡拉比-丘三维流形 O3/O7 定向流形上紧化的轴子势能景观，发现在特定几何构型和微调的总体积稳定条件下，轴子势能能够支持小场暴胀。主要科学发现与核心工作包括：
- 当卡拉比-丘总体积被微调至特殊值时，轴子势能的多个临界点会在“突变”中汇聚，从而创造出一个具有微小梯度和微小黑塞行列式的平坦区域，这正是实现慢滚暴胀的必要条件。
- 开发了一种算法，明确识别出了数个具体的突变实例，这些实例在场域跨度满足 $f / M_{\text{Pl}} \ll 1$ 的情况下，仍能持续数千个 $e$ 折数的暴胀。
- 部分实例能够正确重现观测到的能谱倾斜，但标量微扰振幅存在偏差；另一些实例则能重现观测到的振幅，但能谱倾斜略微偏红。
- 所有示例在慢滚阶段产生的张量微扰均可忽略，且不具有显著的非高斯性。这些结果证明，在凯勒模稳定于特殊体积值的条件下，弦理论轴子无需依赖对齐机制或大场域跨度，即可成为宇宙暴胀的来源。
summary: In the landscape of compactifications of type IIB string theory on O3/O7 orientifolds of Calabi--Yau threefolds, we identify regions of the axion potential in specific geometries that support small-field inflation, under the assumption that the overall Calabi--Yau volume can be stabilized at certain tuned values. At the tuned volume multiple critical points of the axion potential merge in a ``catastrophe'', creating a region with small gradient and small Hessian determinant --- necessary conditions for slow-roll inflation. We describe an algorithm that identifies several explicit examples of these catastrophes that have small field range $f / M_{\rm Pl} \ll 1 $ yet inflate for thousands of efolds. Some examples correctly reproduce the observed spectral tilt but not the amplitude of scalar perturbations, while others reproduce the observed amplitude but with a tilt that is slightly too red. All our examples have negligible tensor perturbations and no significant non-Gaussianity generated during the slow-roll phase. Our results demonstrate that string theory axions can be the source of cosmic inflation without alignment or large field ranges, provided that the Kähler moduli can be stabilized at special values of the volume.

title: A Radio-Bright Local Little Red Dot Analog
background_knowledge: 詹姆斯·韦布空间望远镜（JWST）在早期宇宙（$z > 4$）中发现了大量被称为“小红点”（Little Red Dots, LRDs）的特殊天体。这些天体呈现出致密、红且高光度的特征，普遍认为内部容纳了正在快速生长的超大质量黑洞（SMBH），并伴随着同期的核区恒星暴发。在早期宇宙中，高红移 LRDs 通常在射电波段无法被探测到，这限制了对其射电辐射机制、喷流活动以及黑洞反馈过程的深入理解。为了克服高红移观测的局限性，天文学家通过在较低红移（$z < 1$）宇宙中搜寻具有相似物理特征的“本地小红点类似物”（LLRDs），从而得以利用高灵敏度的射电望远镜深入解析这类特殊系统的射电连续谱特征、辐射机制及其与超大质量黑洞演化的内在联系。
contribution:
本文报道了对本地小红点类似物天体 J204837.26-002437.2（简称为 J2048，红移 $z = 0.4332$）的射电连续谱探测结果。这是继此前发现两例 LLRD 射电辐射后的又一重要探测，且该源在 3.0 GHz 频率下的通量密度达到 $3.0 \pm 0.2\text{ mJy}$，其射电光度比以往探测到的同类天体高出两个数量级。主要科学发现包括：
- 谱指数 $\alpha = -0.39 \pm 0.04$，表明其射电辐射与中等光学厚度的同步辐射相一致。
- J2048 的射电光度为 $1.2 \times 10^{41}\ \mathrm{erg\ s^{-1}}$，处于射电响亮的巨型椭圆星系和类星体光度范围（$10^{41-46}\ \mathrm{erg\ s^{-1}}$）的低端。
- 该源中心超大质量黑洞的预期射电光度大约高出一个量级，暗示其当前射电光度可能受到了某种机制的强力抑制。
- 若宇宙学早期（$z > 4$）的 LRD 具有与 J2048 类似的光度水平，通过甚大阵（VLA）进行中等积分时间的观测将能够被有效探测到。
summary: The James Webb Space Telescope revealed the existence in the early Universe ($z >$ 4) of large populations of little red dots (LRDs), compact red luminous sources that host rapidly growing supermassive black holes (SMBHs) surrounded by coeval nuclear starbursts. LRDs have defining properties, one of which is the absence of radio detections. LRDs could be radio-undetected because of their large distances. A way to investigate the radio properties of LRDs is to search for radio emission in their local analogs, the Local Little Red Dot (LLRD) galaxies at $z <$ 1 with analogous properties to LRDs. We report the radio continuum detection of the LLRD analog J204837.26${-}$002437.2 ($z$ = 0.4332, hereinafter J2048). This adds to the previous radio detection of two other LLRDs. However, with a flux density of 3.0$\pm$0.2 mJy at 3.0 GHz, J2048 is two orders of magnitude more radio luminous than the previous detections. The spectral index of $α$ = -0.39$\pm$0.04 is consistent with moderately optically-thick synchrotron emission. The radio luminosity of J2048 is $1.2 \times 10^{41}~ \mathrm{erg ~s^{-1}}$, in the lower end of the range defined by radio-loud giant elliptical galaxies and quasars of $L_R$ = $10^{41-46} ~\mathrm{erg ~s^{-1}}$. The expected radio luminosity of the SMBH associated with J2048 is estimated to be about an order of magnitude larger, suggesting that its radio luminosity could potentially be strongly dimmed. A cosmological ($z >$ 4) LRD with radio luminosity similar to that of J2048 would be detectable using the VLA with moderately long integrations.

title: Infrared Spectroscopy of Cyanonaphthalenes under Interstellar Relevant Conditions and Their Potential Connection with Astronomical Aromatic Infrared Bands
background_knowledge: 芳香族红外带（AIBs）广泛存在于各类天体环境中，通常被普遍认为是由多环芳烃（PAHs）分子的振动激发辐射产生的。为了在分子水平上理解这些天体光谱特征的起源与演化，实验室需要模拟星际介质（ISM）的极端物理条件——如低温和气相环境——来测量相关分子的精密红外光谱。通过结合高精度的量子化学计算与气相光谱学实验，研究人员能够准确识别特定分子（如含杂原子或取代基的 PAH 衍生物）的振动模式，这对于解析星际有机分子复杂化学网络、追踪碳元素在宇宙中的循环具有重要的基础科学意义。
contribution:
本文在冷分子束中利用离子 dip 光谱技术测量了中性 1-CNN 和 2-CNN 在与星际介质相关的气相条件下的红外光谱。主要工作与发现包括：
- 结合 B3LYP/N07D 级别的谐波和非谐波计算，详细归属了 1-CNN 和 2-CNN 的基频振动、泛频及组合频。
- 通过单光子近似框架模拟了其红外发射光谱，发现其在多个与显著 AIBs 相对应的波段区域表现出特征发射，包括约 $3.3\ \mu\text{m}$ 处的芳香族 CH 伸缩振动区、约 $6.2\ \mu\text{m}$ 处的 CC 伸缩振动区、$8.6\ \mu\text{m}$ 至 $8.9\ \mu\text{m}$ 的混合 CH 面内弯曲与 CC 伸缩振动区，以及 $10\ \mu\text{m}$ 到 $15\ \mu\text{m}$ 之间的 CH 面外弯曲振动区。
- 提供了小型氰基取代多环芳烃的高精度实验室参考数据，为解释特定的 AIBs 区域提供了有力线索，表明氰基萘分子是空间 AIBs 的重要潜在贡献者。
summary: Context. Aromatic infrared bands (AIBs) are widely observed in diverse astrophysical environments and are generally attributed to vibrational emission from polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs). The recent interstellar detection of 1-cyanonaphthalene (1-CNN) and 2-cyanonaphthalene (2-CNN) has motivated detailed infrared spectroscopic studies of cyano-substituted PAHs. Aims. We aim to characterize the infrared spectra and vibrational modes of neutral 1-CNN and 2-CNN under cold and gas-phase conditions and to assess their possible spectroscopic relevance to the astronomical AIBs. Methods. The gas-phase infrared spectra of neutral 1-CNN and 2-CNN were measured in a cold molecular beam using ion-dip spectroscopy. The observed bands were assigned with the aid of harmonic and anharmonic calculations at the B3LYP/N07D level. Infrared emission spectra were subsequently simulated from the experimental spectra within a single-photon approximation framework. Results. We report the infrared spectra of neutral 1-CNN and 2-CNN measured under cold and gas-phase conditions relevant to the interstellar medium. Their vibrational features were assigned in detail, including fundamental vibrations as well as overtone and combination bands. The simulated emission spectra exhibit features in several wavelength regions associated with prominent AIBs, including the aromatic CH stretching region near 3.3 micron, the CC stretching region near 6.2 micron, the mixed CH in-plane bending and CC stretching region at 8.6-8.9 microns, and the CH out-of-plane bending region between 10 and 15 microns. Conclusions. The present spectra provide laboratory reference data for small cyano-substituted PAHs and offer useful clues for interpreting selected AIB regions. These results suggest that cyanonaphthalene molecules are promising contributors to the aromatic infrared bands.

title: Millimeter-wave adaptive optics: Demonstrating closed-loop correction for lowest Zernike modes
background_knowledge: 地面大型毫米波和亚毫米波望远镜在观测宇宙时，常受到风载、热变形等环境因素导致的镜面畸变和波前误差影响，从而限制了望远镜的观测效率与分辨率。与光学和近红外波段传统自适应光学不同，毫米波波段波长较长，传统的可见光波前传感器无法直接适用。因此，发展专用的毫米波自适应光学（MAO）系统，实时测量并闭环校正主镜及系统的低阶 Zernike 模式（如倾斜、离焦等），是保障大口径射电望远镜表面精度与高分辨率成像能力的核心技术支撑。
contribution:
本文报道了一种用于毫米波自适应光学（MAO）的五单元原型波前传感器，通过副镜位移实现了倾斜与离焦等最低阶 Zernike 模式的闭环校正。核心工作与发现包括：
- 基于射电干涉测量原理研制了工作在 20 GHz 的五单元系统，并将其安装在野边山 45 米望远镜上（此前两单元原型系统实现了优于 $10\ \mu\text{m}$ 的精度）。
- 通过“月缘”观测实验，利用连续谱通量的高度相关性，证实了系统对波前梯度的有效探测能力。
- 引入比例-积分控制器闭合了传感器与副镜的反馈回路，稳定地抑制了最低阶 Zernike 模式。
- 这一研究成果为未来如 AtLAST/LST 等大口径亚毫米波设施的波前计量与控制奠定了坚实的技术基础。
summary: We report on a five-element prototype wavefront sensor for millimeter-wave adaptive optics (MAO), enabling closed-loop correction of tip-tilt and defocus via secondary mirror (M2) displacement. MAO is essential for large ground-based millimeter/submillimeter telescopes to maintain surface accuracy under wind and thermal distortions. Our sensor, based on radio interferometry, measures excess path lengths from the primary mirror to a focal-plane receiver. A previous two-element prototype achieved < 10 um accuracy at the Nobeyama 45 m telescope. The new five-element system, operating at 20 GHz, was installed on the same telescope. A ``Moon-edge'' experiment confirmed detection of wavefront gradients through strong correlation with continuum flux. Implementing a PI controller closed the sensor-M2 loop, stably suppressing the lowest Zernike modes. This approach establishes a foundation for metrology in future large-aperture submillimeter facilities such as AtLAST/LST.

title: Brightest group and cluster galaxies as indicators of relaxation
background_knowledge: 星系群和星系团是宇宙中最大的引力束缚系统，是研究宇宙学模型和大尺度结构演化的关键探针。在利用星系团进行宇宙学应用时，通常假设系统处于动力学平衡的弛豫状态。然而，在实际观测中，直接获取暗物质晕的三维动力学信息（如热平衡状态、子结构比例等）极为困难。因此，寻找能够通过中心最亮星系（BHG）及光学观测特征来表征和预测星系团弛豫状态的可靠观测代理指标，是连接理论模拟与天文观测的核心方法。
contribution:
本文基于 IllustrisTNG 宇宙学数值模拟数据，系统研究了星系群和星系团中主晕最亮星系（BHG）的性质，以寻找能够精准预测系统动力学弛豫状态的可靠观测代理指标。主要科学发现包括：
- 证明了 BHG 相对势阱的偏移量 $d_\text{off}$ 以及与第二亮星系的 r 波段星等差 $\Delta m_{12}$ 是指示系统弛豫状态的高效指标，两者的结合使用效果尤为显著。
- 提出了 $d_\text{off} < 0.05\ R_{200}$ 且 $\Delta m_{12} > 1.6\text{ mag}$ 的筛选标准，利用该标准构建的晕质量函数（HMF）与理论定义的纯弛豫暗物质晕样本高度吻合。
- 该筛选准则适用于质量范围 $\text M_{200} \ge 10^{12.5}\ \text M_\odot$（$\text M_{\ast, \text{BHG}} \gtrsim 10^{10.9}\ \text M_\odot$）且红移 $z \sim 0.2$ 以内的观测样本。
- 在此质量范围内，$z = 0$ 时约有 15% - 23% 的系统处于完全弛豫状态；弛豫暗物质晕的比例在红移 $z \sim 0.4$ 之前随红移显著下降，此后下降速率明显减缓。
summary: Context. Galaxy groups and clusters are widely used to probe the evolution of the cosmic web and cosmology, while assuming that they are relaxed. Aims. We identify the properties of the brightest halo galaxies (BHGs) that can be used to predict the most likely sample of dynamically relaxed host halos. Our work combines thoroughly studied galaxy clusters with less frequently analysed groups. Methods. Our analysis was based on data from the IllustrisTNG simulations. We considered several observationally motivated parameters, including the offset of the BHG from the potential well of the host system ($d_\text{off}$) and from the r-band luminosity centre ($d_\text{lum}$), the distance between the brightest and second-brightest galaxies ($d_{12}$), and the r-band magnitude gap between them ($Δm_{12}$). The primary analysis was performed at redshift $z=0$, with an additional investigation of the redshift evolution of halo relaxation up to $z=1$. The observable proxies were applied to construct a halo mass function (HMF), which was then compared to the HMF of the relaxed sample defined from 3D information commonly used in theoretical approaches. Results. We find that $d_\text{off}$ and $Δm_{12}$ are effective indicators of group and cluster relaxation, particularly when used in combination. The selection criteria of $d_\text{off}<0.05~R_{200}$ and $Δm_{12}>1.6$ mag allowed us to reproduce an HMF that closely matches that of the relaxed halo population. These criteria can be applied to observations up to $z\sim0.2$ within a mass range $\text M_{200}\geq10^{12.5}\text M_\odot$ ($\text M_\text{*, BHG}\gtrsim10^{10.9}\text M_\odot$), including groups and clusters in the selection. In this mass range, $15-23\%$ of the systems are considered fully relaxed at $z=0$. The fraction of relaxed haloes decreases with redshift up to $z\sim0.4$, after which the decrease is far slower.

title: Tradeoff between segment density and IWA for high-contrast imaging of exoplanets with a large segmented space mission
background_knowledge: 为了直接成像类地系外行星，未来的大型空间望远镜（如宜居世界天文台 HWO）需要使用星冕仪在很小的角分离处实现高达 $10^{-10}$ 的极高对比度。这要求主镜的子镜相位控制精度达到皮米量级，给光学工程带来了极大的技术挑战。为了缓解这一严苛的硬件约束，研究人员通常通过系统层面的优化来设计望远镜和仪器，例如调整主镜的分块方案以及焦平面掩模的内工作角（IWA）。这种协同设计能够有效提升系统在子镜相位像差下的性能稳定性，是降低下一代空间高对比度成像任务技术风险的核心途径之一。
contribution:
本论文定量评估了大型分块空间望远镜在系外行星高对比度成像中，子镜密度与焦平面掩模内工作角（IWA）之间的权衡关系。主要核心工作与发现包括：
- 提出了一种系统层面的优化方法，通过调整主镜分块方案和焦平面掩模尺寸，评估了系统对子镜相位像差的被动鲁棒性以及泽尼克低阶波前传感器（Zernike low-order wavefront sensor）的像差重构能力。
- 研究发现，增大焦平面掩模半径（例如从 $3.5\lambda/D$ 增至 $6.5\lambda/D$）或减少子镜数量（例如从 85 块减少至 7 块），能够将相位控制约束分别放宽最多 4 倍和 2 倍。
- 掩模半径的增大同时也使传感器对光子噪声的敏感度在活塞、倾斜和顶角模式下平均提升了一倍。
- 结论表明，联合优化分块方案与掩模尺寸以阻挡低阶功率谱密度包络，能够显著放宽对相位控制的要求，并与主动波前校正形成有效互补，对 HWO 等未来任务具有直接指导意义。
summary: Imaging Earth-like exoplanets with coronagraphs on future large segmented space telescopes such as the Habitable Worlds Observatory requires contrasts down to $10^{-10}$ at separations below 100 mas, imposing segment phasing control down to a few picometers. We evaluate how this constraint can be relaxed by optimizing telescope and instrument design, quantifying the impact on performance stability under segment phasing aberrations. We propose a system-level approach, adjusting the primary mirror segmentation and the focal-plane mask size (inner working angle). We compare the passive robustness to segment phasing errors across systems, and the ability of a Zernike low-order wavefront sensor to reconstruct aberrations and recover target performance. Increasing the focal-plane mask radius or decreasing segment count improves both passive robustness and sensor reconstruction: Increasing the mask radius from 3.5 to 6.5λ/D relaxes phasing constraints by up to a factor 4 near the IWA, and reducing the segment count from 85 (5 rings) to 7 (1 ring) relaxes them by up to a factor 2; The same mask radius increase also doubles, on average, the sensor's sensitivity to photon noise across segment piston, tip, and tilt modes. To conclude, jointly optimizing the segmentation scheme and mask size, so the low-order PSD envelope is blocked by the mask, can significantly relax phasing requirements, complementing active correction, with direct implications for HWO.

title: Exact spherical-wave forward model for radio reflection from stratified media
background_knowledge: 超高能粒子（能量 $\gtrsim 10^{18}\ \text{eV}$ 的宇宙线与中微子）的射电探测是现代天体粒子物理学的重要前沿。当这些粒子与大气或致密介质相互作用产生宽带射电脉冲时，脉冲在自然介质边界（如南极冰盖、月球风化层）的反射特性直接决定了信号的波形与极性。在实际环境中，冰盖表面通常存在密度随深度变化的雪层或分层介质（firn 叠层）。精确建模球面电磁波在复杂分层介质中的反射与传播，对于消除地表多径效应、解释诸如 ANITA 异常极性事件以及标定类似 HiCal 的搭载实验具有至关重要的作用。
contribution:
本文提出了一种针对分层介质射电反射的精确球面波正演模型，主要核心工作与科学发现包括：
- **扩展球面波处理方法**：将单一边界面上的球面波（Sommerfeld-Weyl）处理方法推广至分层介质，通过在球面局部切平面上用分层介质特征矩阵的反射系数替代单平面波菲涅耳系数，构建了精确的正演框架。
